articles.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
articles.abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

articles.titleCn: 面向大型语言模型社交代理的上下文增强与选择性鲁棒性框架
articles.abstractCn: 研究人员将大型语言模型作为社会模拟中的代理，通过提示观察和背景信息来塑造代理的行为。然而，研究表明，在意义保持的提示变化下，LLM代理的行为会发生显著改变，这对社会模拟构成了验证问题。一个合理的假设是，这种脆弱性反映了缺乏根基，可以通过丰富提供给代理的上下文来减少。但更丰富的上下文是否能提高鲁棒性尚不明确，部分原因在于上下文丰富性和鲁棒性很少以支持受控比较的方式定义。我们通过受控上下文丰富来解决第一个需求，这是一套提示替换规则，系统地丰富不同类型的上下文：中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策根基和规范性决策根基。我们通过引入选择性鲁棒性作为验证标准来解决第二个需求：对意义保持的提示变化不敏感，同时对社会世界中与决策相关的变化做出定向响应。我们在一个类似囚徒困境的游戏中展示了该框架，展示了如何使用它来识别哪些上下文丰富形式能产生更理想和鲁棒的代理行为。我们发现，这些丰富形式产生了不同的行为模式，并且在这两个测试模型之间存在差异。

articles.title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
articles.abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.
articles.titleCn: SpecCompact：通过槽位并行语义推测验证加速LLM代理上下文压缩
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理使用上下文压缩来管理不断增长的交互历史，但使用大型模型对长历史进行总结可能会引入显著的延迟。因此，压缩需要在信息保留和延迟之间进行权衡。我们观察到，当独立生成时，结构化摘要槽可以保留信息。基于这一观察，我们提出了SpecCompact，一个通过槽并行语义推测加速压缩的框架。SpecCompact微调一个小型起草者，并并行生成槽。目标模型验证每行提议并修复被拒绝的内容，而后续起草则使用更新的槽前缀。系统优化进一步减少了重复的上下文处理和模型调用。在AppWorld和$τ^3$基准测试中，使用两个目标模型，SpecCompact比Hermes风格的总结实现了2.04--5.63倍的压缩速度提升。单独的下游评估揭示了模型和任务相关的性能权衡。在Hermes内的用户研究进一步表明，压缩速度中位数提升了8.68倍。

articles.title: Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
articles.abstract: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

articles.titleCn: 平衡层次表示和量化：文本嵌入中的性能权衡
articles.abstractCn: 分层文本嵌入模型提供可变长度的表示，而量化会降低数值精度；两者都旨在提高计算效率。本研究是对这两种正交且已建立的技术的交互作用进行的实证基准研究。我们使用四种基于Transformer的嵌入模型，涵盖1D和2D分层表示与32位、8位和二进制量化相结合，对Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)中的38项任务进行评估，每个任务有168种配置。我们分别报告每个效率维度：理论每向量存储和端到端评估时间。在Friedman检验和Nemenyi事后分析下，int8量化在成对分类和重新排序方面与float32在统计上无显著差异，总体成本最多相差1.5个百分点，而二进制量化在所有任务类别中都显著更差。当嵌入维度减半一次时，在m=16以上无法在统计上检测到差异；连续减半两次总是可以检测到。将8倍维度减少与int8结合，可在94.4%的基线效果下将每向量存储减少32倍。由于评估时间只测量一次，我们将其视为指示值：我们发现没有证据表明量化会加速评估，而从中层抽样会显著缩短评估时间。检索的性能下降速度远快于其他所有类别，因此我们按任务类别报告结果。

articles.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
articles.abstract: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.

articles.titleCn: 长香蕉：一个经专家验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了LongBanana，据我们所知，这是有史以来第一个针对长上下文多参考图像合成的专家设计及专家验证基准，适用于智能体驱动的图像生成时代。该任务要求检索分散的视觉证据、排除干扰项、绑定实体与关系，并从多个参考中合成一个连贯的最终图像。LongBanana包含90个精心设计的任务，按3x3分类体系组织；每个任务包括约32张参考图像、20个约束条件和50个评估项，总共产生4,670个专家指定的原子评估项。其基于图的评估设计通过为每个任务配置参考图像和实体关系图来实例化任务，然后将节点、边和整个图的义务转化为内容保真度、关系绑定和全局约束满足的清单项。专家评审标签包括一个15%的双标签子集，精确一致率为89.4%，Kappa系数为0.83。我们进一步介绍了LongBanana-Gen，这是一个用于长时程图像生成的智能体框架；实验表明，最小智能体框架优于直接生成，而ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect（RPR）工作流程通过强化证据基础和修复来获得依赖智能体的增益。综合来看，LongBanana提供了一个可审计的测试平台，用于测量密集视觉证据的使用，并作为开发更强智能体驱动图像生成系统的共同目标。代码和数据可在项目页面获取：https://long-banana.com/。

articles.title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
articles.abstract: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.
articles.titleCn: 角色视角：采用观点重组大型语言模型的表征
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型（LLMs）如线性探针和稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）等常见特征监控方法，通常假设特征在不同上下文中保持一致的表征。然而，LLMs能够灵活地采用不同的视角或“角色”，这些角色暗示着不同的概念关系底层系统。本文研究了提示LLMs采用角色是否会改变模型潜在空间的表征几何结构。我们从采用自由主义和保守主义政治角色的模型中提取了超过9000个常见词和33个语义轴的表征，并与两个中性基线进行比较。我们发现，角色条件作用会系统性地改变词汇在语义轴上的投影以及轴之间的对齐方式，这些改变与指定的意识形态方向一致。随后，我们测试了这种重组对两个与安全相关的特征——真实性和道德性——的影响。未经角色提示训练的线性探针、基于SAEs的分类器以及由人工选择词表征构建的分类器，在应用于被政治角色条件作用的模型时产生了不同的结果，导致对争议性陈述的真实性和道德性评价带有政治倾向。这些发现表明，当模型采用角色时，传统提取的内部表征可能表现出不同的几何关系，从而可能削弱监控工作。

articles.title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.
articles.titleCn: 在进行下一步之前：评估对话助手中的时间敏感安全意识
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手越来越多地帮助用户处理涉及时间依赖性约束的日常活动。然而，用户可能在后续请求中未提及这些约束，这要求助手能够识别并相应调整其建议。为了评估这种能力，我们引入了TASC（对话中的时间动作安全），这是一个评估LLM在响应对话请求时是否应用时间依赖性约束的基准。TASC包含3,418个从128个模板派生的输入，以及一个单独的包含33个场景的集合，用于比较模型计算经过时间的能力与其应用这些信息的能力。在13个模型中，助手仅在30.5%的违反规则的建议情况下考虑了时间依赖性约束，而很少在不必要的情况下向用户发出警告。更重要的是，尽管模型正确计算了经过时间，但在62.1%的情况下未能应用这些约束。明确提供时间信息仅解决了大约一半的这些失败案例，揭示了时间推理与其在对话建议中的应用之间存在差距。

articles.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
articles.abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.
articles.titleCn: LooM：因果编码器-解码器语言模型的循环不变内存
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过重复执行共享层来增加有效深度，但三种限制阻碍了其应用：内存随循环次数增长、计算只能以整块步长调整、循环次数在训练后难以改变。我们提出了LooM（循环不变内存），逐一解决这些问题。在因果编码器-解码器（CED）中，LooM仅循环第一个解码器之后的层，这些层读取每个token一次性写入的全局内存，并且每个层仅在其第一次访问时发布token的键值（KV）条目，因此缓存不会随循环次数增长。这些层独立循环，为每个token提供从3到21层执行预算，一个在随机采样预算上训练的模型无需路由器即可涵盖所有情况。随着足够的循环次数，LooM在使用相同缓存大小的情况下，在语言建模、零样本准确率和长上下文困惑度上优于在相同数据上训练的单次通过基线。我们的分析进一步表明，训练预算分布决定了额外深度带来的收益。这些结果表明，CED是循环的理想场所：内存仅写入一次，深度成为部署时选择的预算。

articles.title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
articles.abstract: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

articles.titleCn: 基于对话蕴涵的摘要分析
articles.abstractCn: 随着对大型语言模型（LLMs）及其在语音领域的应用评估需求的日益增长，在总结和评估缺乏明确目标对话时仍存在挑战。我们引入了SAUCE——一种无参考、基于事实的跨语言对话语音总结评估流程。该流程通过对话与文本之间的蕴涵关系来衡量摘要的准确性和事实覆盖范围。我们将SAUCE与几种流行的总结指标进行了比较，并展示了其有效捕捉转录和翻译错误导致的信息损失以及识别错误摘要的能力。关键的是，与黑盒LLM评估器或密集嵌入指标不同，SAUCE具有内在的可解释性：它将摘要分数映射到离散、可验证的事实，允许用户精确地定位具体的幻觉或遗漏。我们阐述了这种可解释性如何帮助开发者系统地分析LLM行为，并为最终用户提供了一个在嘈杂的实时条件下验证摘要准确性的实用工具。初步研究表明，SAUCE与人类判断高度一致。

articles.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
articles.abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型不知道自己知道什么：金融回测的时间自我认知基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的金融后测只有在模型本身不知道其预测结果的情形下才有意义。从业者通过信任供应商声称的知识截止日期、询问模型其掌握的信息，或指示模型以某个过去的日期来回答等方式来防范此类风险。为了验证这些防范措施是否可靠，我们引入了FinDendro，这是一个包含1999年至2026年2226个日期标注的美国事实基准，涵盖了月度宏观经济序列、月末股价和美联储决策。每个事实都会生成四个提示：一个值问题、一个回忆和预测问题，将每个候选值与一个未声明日期的知晓或猜测声明配对，以及一个带有历史声明日期的预测问题。持久性和主导结果的控制使偶然准确率保持在0.27左右。结果表明，对于大多数前沿模型，自我报告的知晓程度往往被低估。GPT-5正确回答了76%的受控事实，但声称知晓38%，并且对于其声称不知道的事实，正确回答了61%。知识声明可以持续超出测量知识边界，长达七个季度，而声明的日期则消除了大部分先验知识声明，同时准确率保持不变。因此，在模型训练窗口内的后测无法通过自我报告、指令或声明的截止日期来确保无泄露。这些发现推动了时间知识边界的实证测量，FinDendro提供了一个基于已证明事实知识选择后测周期的基准和程序。

articles.title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
articles.abstract: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.
articles.titleCn: 衡量风险，而非伤害：检测大型语言模型对话中的心理伤害风险因素
articles.abstractCn: 与大型语言模型的交互可能带来的心理伤害无法直接监测，因为它们可能随着重复交互而出现，并且强烈依赖于主观的个体用户环境。我们提出测量风险而非伤害：在AI响应层面检测构成心理伤害风险因素的可观察AI行为，并将这些信号聚合以支持纵向监测。我们操作化了八种此类行为，构建了一个包含47,062个AI响应和373,873个响应-因素标签的合成多标签语料库，并进行了针对性的人工标注以用于验证和评估。随后，我们比较了基于嵌入的分类器、直接LLM评判以及分类器-评判级联。所有检测器都是模型无关的，仅操作LLM输出，无需访问内部模型状态。我们将这些检测器应用于先前研究中几个分布外的人类-AI对话数据集。在保留的人类标注数据上，最佳级联实现了宏观精确度0.86、召回率0.76和F1值0.79。在WildChat上，它相对于直接评判减少了97.1%的LLM-评判调用。在DelusionEval上，风险因素检测在对话中聚集。综合我们的结果表明，响应层面的行为风险因素检测可以在不混淆可观察AI行为与潜在用户伤害的情况下，为纵向心理安全监测提供可扩展的测量层。

articles.title: Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
articles.abstract: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.
articles.comment: 38 pages including supplementary methods and results; 10 figures and 22 tables
articles.titleCn: 排名一致性并不能揭示两篇已发布的论文接受预测器中的段落编辑一致性
articles.abstractCn: 一个快速接受的分类器可以挑选出供较慢评估器使用的修订版本。我们询问现有论文上的共识是否支持这种使用方式。我们将一个基于单词和文档特征的分类器与两个从相同的三十亿参数语言模型微调发布的纯文本接受预测器进行比较。对于国际学习表征会议的198篇论文，我们比较了原始论文和经过自动筛选以保持事实不变、主张强度和归因的段落重写的模型排名。该分类器与一个预测器对原始论文的排名非常接近，与另一个预测器中等接近，但在哪个重写会提高分数上，与两个预测器均未显示出可检测的共识。预先指定的测试使用了降低的数值精度。舍入误差主导了小的分数响应。因此，我们以完整的32位精度重新评分了发布的权重，作为事后检查；编辑一致性仍然接近于零。在这种精度下，当每个预测器为每篇论文选择五个重写时，其平均原始分数比随机选择高出不到100分中的两点。证据涵盖了演示重写和来自同一系列的两个公开预测器；迁移到昂贵的评估器尚未得到测试。因此，修订版本选择器应该在它们排名的修订版本上针对预期的评估器进行检查。

articles.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
articles.abstract: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.
articles.titleCn: 基于小语言模型的壳输出模拟模板间隙重建
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型为在不执行提交命令的情况下进行外壳模拟提供了紧凑的基础，但全输出解码要求它们预测在执行过程中反复出现的工具结构以及内容变化的部分。我们引入了模板间隙重建（TGR），它提供可重用的输出字面量，与作为哨兵插入的间隙交错，这些间隙是自回归生成的。模板选择器选择要重建的模板，空模板保留全输出解码。我们从跨越异构执行环境的1870万条输出中构建了一个模板库，并在排除在库构建之外的靶环境中训练了一个模板选择器和五个从不同小型语言模型检查点初始化的重建模型。评估表明，当最优模板覆盖超过25%的模板时，TGR在全输出解码（FOD）的基础上提高了输出编辑相似度（O-ES），而对于低覆盖率输出则表现相似。此外，TGR在较短的间隙序列中优于FOD，O-ES值分别为0.964和0.812，而在较长的序列中保持相似性能。TGR在使用的不同分词器家族中减少了26.3--38.3%的token生成数量。这些结果支持将可重用的输出结构作为小型外壳模拟器的实用设计选择，提高了响应保真度，缩短了生成目标，同时将模板选择和残差预测作为响应质量的核心。

articles.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
articles.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.
articles.titleCn: 基于回合级别的信用分配推进基于流的视频强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 流媒体视频理解需要模型反复决定是否回应或继续观察。近期，组相对策略优化（GRPO）已被应用于这一场景，现有方法侧重于奖励设计，同时保留跨回合的单一路径级优势。这种共享信用可能会在早期成功后强化冗余的回应，并在早期失败后抑制有用的后续操作。我们提出了TurnWise，一个回合级GRPO框架，使学习与单个流媒体决策保持一致。TurnWise解决了路径级反馈与回合级交互之间的不匹配问题，促进了信息量丰富的回应并减少了冗余。具体而言，回合级信用分配使用沉默完成的前缀评分来从每个决策的剩余回报中构建组相对优势，将其学习信号与早期的奖励分离。回合均值策略优化在每个回合内平均标记损失，然后在回合间进行平均，无论输出长度如何，都给予回应和等待决策相同的权重。这些互补设计在不依赖学习型评价器或额外滚动的条件下，提升了流媒体策略学习。大量实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的流媒体视频理解强化学习方法。

articles.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 基于认知分析的多语言大语言模型中非参数化记忆推理：关系知识的认知研究
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）假设语言模型能够对其上下文中陈述的关系进行推理，而不是依赖于预训练期间记忆的关联。我们独立研究这种证据条件下的关系推理，其中事实直接在提示中提供，而不是检索。Rel-Bloom是一个基于30个Wikidata关系的受控多语言诊断测试，包含450道多项选择题；相同的源关系在以Bloom为灵感的五个水平（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评估）和三种真实性条件下（事实性、反事实性、中性化）进行实例化。在43个模型、六种语言和两种多语言设置（226,800次预测）中，有三个发现尤为突出。首先，在所有评估的开权模型系列中，准确率从应用到分析急剧下降，大型Granite桶达到47.2个百分点，但Gemini模型并未出现这种情况。其次，评估项目仍然是瓶颈，即使对于在其他任务类型上接近上限的模型也是如此：Gemini~3.1 Pro在其他四个水平上平均达到99.5%，但在评估上只有60.7%。第三，项目和关系级别的难度排名在不同语言中始终如一地保持一致，表明在这个基准中，不同语言之间存在部分共享的难度结构。在知识条件下，反事实性环境通常比事实性环境更难，而移除实体身份可以在某些模型机制中提高高级性能。因此，更强的模型能力并不能单独确保对提供的关联证据进行可靠推理。相关资源可在以下链接获取：https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning。

articles.title: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
articles.abstract: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.
articles.comment: 8 pages main body, 10 pages appendix, 1 figure
articles.titleCn: ALTO：非洲和黎凡特地区技术辅助性别暴力语料库
articles.abstractCn: 技术辅助的性别暴力（TFGBV）是一种普遍存在的在线伤害，通过其多种直接和隐蔽的形式，影响女性和性别少数群体。当前用于性别化伤害检测的模型和标注数据集主要基于全球北方语言的数据，以及在这些语言中训练的模型。我们与来自约旦、法语西非和肯尼亚的公民社会组织（CSO）合作，开发了一种社区主导的方法，以收集黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语和斯瓦希里语中具有文化和语言相关性的TFGBV实例。我们使用主动学习对收集到的数据进行标注，以开发一个规模虽小但性能优异的数据集（N=3022），命名为ALTO，旨在提高这三种语言中TFGBV的检测能力。通过基准测试和微调实验，我们表明现有的有害内容检测模型在ALTO中的TFGBV召回率表现不佳，但通过微调可以得到改善。我们发现，所有语言中的模型都经常遗漏隐蔽的伤害，而斯瓦希里语的错误率显著更高。我们报告了实验结果，并发布了标注分类体系、数据集和训练好的模型。

articles.title: Beyond accuracy: what AI assurance needs to establish in public services
articles.abstract: Public bodies increasingly rely on AI-produced evidence, including classifications, summaries and assessments. These outputs can inform policy decisions and service delivery, making their reliability a matter of public accountability. Establishing whether this evidence can be relied upon requires testing its outputs and examining how organisations decide whether those tests are sufficient. We combine technical evaluation with analysis of AI governance requirements, informed by measurement theory and management-based regulation. We compare eight GPT-4o configurations classifying 1,200 UK Prime Minister's Questions into 21 policy topics, against human-coded labels and across unchanged repeats. Accuracy ranges from 68.2% to 70.3%, yet 24.3% of questions receive different labels, with changes in topic shares and rankings. Configurations agree more with one another than with human coding: agreement does not guarantee correctness. Under the implemented score-extraction procedure, the proportion flagged for human review ranges from 0.9% to 41.0%. We analyse 37 UK and EU policy documents. Both sets expect testing and oversight, but reporting expectations do not consistently cover changing answers, shared errors, selective evaluation, substantive conclusions or review routing. Some UK guidance explicitly addresses stability. The UK sample emphasises public bodies checking their own use; the EU places substantial testing duties on providers while leaving them important choices about measures and acceptance thresholds. Without appropriate checks, evidence could misrepresent policy issues, redirect attention or resources, and leave errors undetected. Public policy should require organisations to justify reliance through checks beyond aggregate accuracy, clear responsibility, access to expertise and scrutiny of results.
articles.titleCn: 超越准确性：人工智能保障在公共服务中需要建立什么
articles.abstractCn: 公共机构越来越依赖人工智能生成的证据，包括分类、摘要和评估。这些输出可以用于政策决策和服务提供，因此其可靠性成为公共问责的一部分。要确定这些证据是否可靠，需要测试其输出并检查机构如何决定这些测试是否充分。我们结合技术评估与人工智能治理要求的分析，借鉴测量理论和基于管理的监管方法。我们比较了八种GPT-4o配置，将1,200个英国首相质询分类为21个政策主题，与人工编码标签和重复不变的测试结果进行对比。准确率在68.2%至70.3%之间，但仍有24.3%的问题获得了不同的标签，导致主题比例和排名发生变化。配置之间的一致性高于与人工编码的一致性：一致性并不保证正确性。在实施的评分提取程序下，需要人工审核的比例在0.9%至41.0%之间。我们分析了37份英国和欧盟的政策文件。两组文件都要求进行测试和监督，但报告要求并未始终涵盖答案变化、共同错误、选择性评估、实质性结论或审核路由。英国的一些指南明确提到了稳定性问题。英国样本强调公共机构检查自身使用情况；欧盟则将大量测试责任分配给提供者，同时让他们在措施和接受阈值方面拥有重要选择权。如果没有适当的检查，证据可能会歪曲政策问题，转移注意力或资源，并导致错误未被察觉。公共政策应要求组织通过除总体准确率之外的检查、明确的责任、获取专业知识和审查结果来证明其依赖性。

articles.title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.
articles.comment: Chapter 5 of "LLMs in Political and Social Science: Principles and Applications of Transformer Models," Oxford University Press, forthcoming 2027. Data and code: https://github.com/llms-political-social-science-book-oup/book-code-data
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型在政治与社会科学研究中的可复制性、可再现性与鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 本章探讨了使用大型语言模型进行研究的中心可重复性问题。LLM的输出具有概率性，并且在不同的模型和版本之间存在差异，这会对下游的统计结果产生显著影响。本章区分了可复制性、可再现性和鲁棒性，并提出了基于结果分布而非相同输出的概率标准。本章介绍了一种标准化的提示脚本，测试了模型内编码器和解码器的变异性，并发展了误差结构分析以诊断模型出错的位置及其错误是否一致。通过三个数据集，本章表明测量选择可以逆转下游回归系数的符号。现有的基于设计的校正方法使用金标签子样本可以恢复有效性，但代价是估计精度降低。本章的主要贡献是一种堆叠集成开放权重模型，它在校正步骤中提高了精度，同时保留了估计的有效性。

articles.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
articles.abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

articles.titleCn: 总结何时变成指令？LLM代理自我编写的交接总结中的不受支持策略
articles.abstractCn: 长时间运行的LLM代理会压缩其上下文，用摘要替换大部分历史记录。我们探究了交接摘要是否声明了记录不支持的权限或要求，这些句子是否改变了下一个实例（继任者）的行为，以及它们来源。合成工具使用任务带有真实权限账本；相同快照重放会重新运行继任者，并将那些完整句子替换为中性填充。两个AI阅读器仅阅读规则标记的保留摘要，确认了两个开放权重模型中所有可读摘要中1.2%和2.4%的不支持限制，以及0.1%和1.3%的不支持授权。对于限制，预先指定的重放测试没有显著结果（p = 0.58）；随后计划的补充测试发现了一个脆弱效应（p = 0.027）。消除虚假批准将未经授权的行为从120次保留运行中的24次减少到7次（事后分析；后期设定：48次中的17次减少到11次）。大多数开发限制遵循代理早期的推理，即一个行为需要批准（事后分析）。在预先指定的测试中，将系统提示中的“某些行为需要批准。”替换为说明要求来源的提示，将开发摘要中不支持的限制从5.0%减少到1.8%，在保留模板上从1.8%减少到0.3%（两者p < 10^-9），而账本要求的批准请求几乎未改变。代码和数据：https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

articles.title: Dialect Matters: A Dialect-Aware Baseline for Igala-English Machine Translation
articles.abstract: The massive permeability of intelligent systems in every sphere of human activities have greatly enhanced clarity, ease of work, and increased general global understanding which has significantly awaken the use of intelligent systems by all users. Intelligent systems greatly rely on precise dataset/corpus for the correctness of their output. Despite efforts by researchers to address Low-resource language in the Natural Language Processing (NLP), Igala still has zero parallel corpora despite efforts by researchers. We present a dialect-aware baseline for Igala-English machine translation, among first open systems and first with dialectal variation analysis. Our dataset of 1137 sentences (899 training) is first with dialect tags: Idah 459 (40.4%), Ankpa 297 (26.1%), Ibaji 160 (14.1%), Other 187 (16.4%), Ogugu 32 (2.8%). Same English yields 20-60 Igala forms. Mixed-dialect training achieves balanced BLEU 11.66 versus Idah-only model which drops 4.7 BLEU on Ibaji (13.2 on Idah, 8.5 on Ibaji), proving dialect fairness requires mixing. Fine-tuned from Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul (78M), epoch ablation shows convergence at 8 epochs and overfitting at 15. BLEU 11.66, chrF 46.69. Analysis shows 899 sentences on log-linear trend consistent with African low-resource literature. This work provides first dialectal impact analysis for Igala and establishes baseline for future work.
articles.titleCn: 方言很重要：一种面向方言的伊加拉-英语机器翻译基线模型
articles.abstractCn: 智能系统在人类活动各个领域的巨大渗透性极大地提升了清晰度、工作便利性，并增强了全球普遍理解，这显著唤醒了所有用户对智能系统的应用。智能系统高度依赖精确的数据集/语料库以确保其输出正确性。尽管自然语言处理（NLP）领域的研究人员付出了努力，针对低资源语言，伊加拉语（Igala）仍然缺乏平行语料库，尽管研究人员已做出努力。我们提出了一种针对伊加拉-英语机器翻译的方言感知基线，这是首批公开系统之一，也是首批进行方言变异分析的系统。我们的数据集包含1137个句子（其中899个用于训练），首次标注了方言标签：伊达（Idah）459个（40.4%）、安卡帕（Ankpa）297个（26.1%）、伊巴吉（Ibaji）160个（14.1%）、其他187个（16.4%）、奥古古（Ogugu）32个（2.8%）。相同的英语可产生20-60种伊加拉语形式。混合方言训练实现了11.66的均衡BLEU，而仅使用伊达方言的模型在伊巴吉上下降了4.7个BLEU（伊达为13.2，伊巴吉为8.5），证明方言公平性需要混合训练。从Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul（78M）微调， эпоха消融分析显示在8个epoch时收敛，在15个epoch时过拟合。BLEU 11.66，chrF 46.69。分析显示899个句子呈对数线性趋势，与非洲低资源文献一致。这项工作为伊加拉语提供了首个方言影响分析，并为未来工作建立了基线。

articles.title: NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria
articles.abstract: Multilingual benchmarks for African languages mostly translate generic questions into local languages, measuring linguistic competence but not whether models know facts about Africa. We introduce \naija, a benchmark of factual and statistical questions about Nigeria, authored by native speakers and grounded in authoritative official statistics, with every question available in English, Nigerian Pidgin, \yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa. Answering similar questions for the UK and US yields a country by language matrix that disentangles a language effect (the model knows the fact but degrades in a low-resource language) from a knowledge effect (the fact is absent in every language). Across eight frontier and Nigeria-adapted models, the knowledge effect dominates: English-query accuracy is 49--50\% for the US/UK but 20\% for Nigeria. The language effect is smaller and tracks web representation, degrading from English to \yoruba{} (9 points on Nigeria, up to 24 on US/UK questions). We find scale does not help: the strongest models reach 66--79\% on the UK and the US but none exceed 31\% on Nigerian statistics. Extending to all 54 African countries with our best performing frontier model shows the same profile continent-wide, 96\% on culture and 98\% on politics against 26\% on statistics, so the gap is not specific to Nigeria.
articles.titleCn: NaijaFacts：一个用于在关于尼日利亚的事实中分离语言与知识的框架
articles.abstractCn: 针对非洲语言的多语言基准测试主要将通用问题翻译成当地语言，衡量语言能力但无法判断模型是否了解非洲的相关事实。我们引入了\naija，这是一个关于尼日利亚事实和统计问题的基准测试，由当地作者编写，并基于权威的官方统计数据，每个问题都提供英语、尼日利亚皮钦语、yoruba语、伊博语和豪萨语的版本。针对英国和美国回答类似问题的结果，生成了一个国家按语言的矩阵，将语言效应（模型知道事实但在低资源语言中表现下降）与知识效应（事实在所有语言中均缺失）分离。在八个前沿模型和尼日利亚适配模型中，知识效应占主导地位：英语查询的准确率在英国/美国为49--50%，但在尼日利亚仅为20%。语言效应较小，并反映网络表示，从英语下降到yoruba语（在尼日利亚下降9分，在美国/英国问题中最高可达24分）。我们发现规模提升无济于事：最强的模型在英国和美国达到66--79%，但没有模型在尼日利亚统计数据上超过31%。将我们的最佳前沿模型扩展到所有54个非洲国家，显示出全洲范围内相同的特点：文化领域96%，政治领域98%，但统计数据仅为26%，因此差距并非尼日利亚独有。

articles.title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
articles.abstract: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.
articles.titleCn: CRESiST：用于同时语音翻译的自增强探索性策略学习
articles.abstractCn: 语音同步翻译（SimulST）需要在翻译质量和延迟之间取得平衡。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在离线翻译方面表现出色，但当前的基于LLM的SimulST系统主要依赖前缀增量生成。这种范式存在冗余的键值缓存重新计算问题，并且需要外部语音活动检测来处理无界流。为了克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种基于全模态LLM的端到端交错读写框架。通过交错语音片段和文本标记，我们的架构实现了完整的键值缓存复用，原生支持无分段、无限长推理。此外，为了在不依赖严格的离线对齐的情况下学习最优流策略，我们引入了一种新颖的Actor-Critic自增强流程。RNN-T Actor动态采样读写轨迹，而基于LLM的Critic则通过内在语义和延迟奖励评估这些路径，将最优策略提炼回Actor。在句子级（FLEURS, CoVoST2）和文档级（MuST-C, ACL 60/60）基准上的大量实验表明，我们的模型建立了新的质量-延迟帕累托前沿，显著优于现有的级联和静态对齐基线。

articles.title: LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering
articles.abstract: Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person's name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. We construct different types of real-time question-answer pairs from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio. We evaluate several popular real-time commercial models and find that they still tend to respond only after the speech turn has finished. We demonstrate that we can enable a pretrained SLM to perform this task, where we explore several modeling designs and establish a solid baseline for future research.
