articles.titleCn: LibriSpeech-Real-QA：流式问答基准
articles.abstractCn: 大多数语音大型语言模型（SLM）仍然以离线方式处理语音。它们只有在接收到完整的语音片段后才会开始响应。然而，许多实际应用需要流式语音交互，其中音频持续流入，机器需要根据迄今为止收到的音频片段回答问题。例如，用户可能要求系统在对方讲话时持续统计一个人名字被提及的次数。我们观察到缺乏用于实时语音交互的基准和评估协议。为此，我们提出了LibriSpeech-Real-QA，这是一个用于实时语音交互的数据集和基准。我们从LibriSpeech中构建了不同类型的实时问答对，以评估语音LLM是否能在流式音频中识别目标词。我们评估了几个流行的实时商业模型，发现它们仍然倾向于在语音回合结束后才响应。我们展示了如何使预训练的SLM执行这项任务，其中我们探索了多种建模设计，为未来研究建立了坚实的基础。

articles.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
articles.abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
articles.titleCn: 多轮强化学习究竟在多大程度上改进了大型语言模型代理？
articles.abstractCn: 尽管多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在长时程任务上表现出色，但其性能提升高度依赖于交互约束。通过Pass@(K,T)评估不同采样广度K和交互深度T，我们证明轨迹级RL优势取决于足够的回合预算，当预算收紧时显著下降。此外，智能体RL并非全面提升单步决策质量，其优势集中于错误恢复和长时程韧性。为缓解预算依赖带来的部署风险，我们初步探讨了过程监督信号的优势与局限，并引入BudgetMix RL作为替代方案，该方案在训练中动态调整交互预算。实验证明BudgetMix RL在不同执行环境下均能实现稳健性能。项目页面：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

articles.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
articles.titleCn: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的代理式组合式检索
articles.abstractCn: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过检索从语料库构建的知识图谱来回答问题。然而，检索策略是围绕其自身构建流程产生的结构设计的，而它们是否能在构建方式改变时依然有效，很少得到测试。我们研究了跨构建的可移植性：即一个没有特定构建模式、关系名称或重新调优的检索流程，在图谱构建方式不同时是否依然有效。我们引入了ArcRAG，它在推理时诱导一个查询本地图接口（从问题命名实体可达的节点标签、关系描述符和属性键），针对该接口规划多跳遍历，并以Cypher执行和修复它们。我们将MuSiQue、HotpotQA和TriviaQA语料库分别构建为模式引导图（带类型节点、封闭关系集、来源出处）和开放信息抽取图（无类型节点、自由文本关系），并在这些语料库中固定检索器配置。我们将其与构建无关的Direct-Cypher代理进行比较，在两种图谱家族中分别对每个阶段进行重试和传递预算的消融实验，并与先前报道的GraphRAG系统结果进行比较，这些系统大多将检索与其自身的图谱构建一起设计。在两种构建方式下，我们发现检索不必与图谱共同设计：查询时接口诱导使构建无关的检索器在构建方式改变时依然有效，尽管构建方式仍然影响绝对准确率。

articles.title: EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution
articles.abstract: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.
articles.titleCn: EvoGuard：缓解在线技能进化中的退化问题
articles.abstractCn: 技能使语言代理能够将经验作为自然语言文档跨任务重用。近期研究从交互中演化技能，但现有方法在技能在线演化时存在局限性。先前方法通过收集多个任务中的轨迹批量离线更新技能。其中一些方法在未经任何检查的情况下采用新技能，这可能导致技能随时间退化；另一些方法仅在技能提升在保留的验证集上的性能时才保留它，但每次更新后运行验证集太慢且成本高昂。我们引入了EvoGuard，这是一种成对技能选择器，能够在低延迟和低成本下减轻技能退化。我们首先让代理迭代运行以构建技能池，并在私有测试集上对每个技能进行评分以获得效用标签。我们将技能配对，并使用拒绝采样仅保留具有明显效用差距的对。选择器基于两个标签token的logits进行训练，以选择更好的技能。在部署时，它通过单次前向传递做出决定，这比在私有测试集上进行评估要快得多。与采用每个新技能相比，EvoGuard在ALFWorld上提高了11.0%的成功率，在ScienceWorld上提高了5.9%，在LiveCodeBench上提高了2.7%。

articles.title: Twists and Turns: A Graph-Based Benchmark and Framework for Long-Term Memory in Exploration Tasks
articles.abstract: Long-term problem-solving processes, such as scientific research and software development, proceed along an evolving trial-and-error trajectory toward a central goal. We term these \textit{exploration tasks}, which require models to remember not only facts but also how solutions are tested against intermediate outcomes and early attempts are continually revised or revived. However, existing long-term memory research focuses on factual recall and updates, overlooking the interconnected nature of exploration. We observe that exploration processes naturally form graphs, with branching approaches linked by revisions and reconsiderations. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{LExMem}, a graph-guided benchmark designed to evaluate \underline{\textsc{Mem}}ory in \underline{\textsc{L}}ong-term \underline{\textsc{Ex}}ploration tasks. We model exploration processes as graphs and introduce an evolutionary mechanism to increase their structural complexity, yielding 224 dialogues and 2,018 question-answer instances derived from graph structures. Building on the same insight, we propose \textsc{LExGraph}, a graph-based memory framework that incrementally organizes dialogues into interconnected memory nodes and retrieves evidence through hybrid retrieval and neighbor expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textsc{LExMem} poses a significant challenge to existing retrieval- and memory-based systems, whereas \textsc{LExGraph} achieves superior performance and generalizes effectively to external benchmarks. Codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/LExMem.
articles.titleCn: 曲折探索：基于图的长期记忆基准与框架
articles.abstractCn: 长期问题解决过程，如科学研究与软件开发，沿着不断演进的试错轨迹向中心目标推进。我们将这些过程称为\textit{探索任务}，此类任务要求模型不仅记住事实，还要记住解决方案如何针对中间结果和早期尝试进行测试，以及如何持续修订或重新激活早期尝试。然而，现有的长期记忆研究集中于事实回忆和更新，忽视了探索过程的相互关联性。我们观察到，探索过程自然地形成图结构，其中分支方法通过修订和重新考虑相互连接。受此启发，我们提出了\textsc{LExMem}，这是一个基于图的基准测试，旨在评估\underline{\textsc{Mem}}ory在\underline{\textsc{L}}ong-term\_\underline{\textsc{Ex}}ploration tasks中的表现。我们将探索过程建模为图，并引入进化机制以增加其结构复杂性，从而从图结构中生成224个对话和2,018个问答实例。基于同样的见解，我们提出了\textsc{LExGraph}，这是一个基于图的记忆框架，它将对话逐步组织成相互连接的记忆节点，并通过混合检索和邻居扩展来检索证据。大量实验表明，\textsc{LExMem}对现有的基于检索和记忆的系统提出了重大挑战，而\textsc{LExGraph}则实现了卓越的性能，并能有效地泛化到外部基准测试。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/LExMem获取。

articles.title: Ruby-OPD: Enhancing Pronunciation Controllability and Accuracy for Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech via On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Achieving both high pronunciation accuracy and fine-grained controllability remains a central challenge in Japanese text-to-speech (TTS), as Japanese is an unsegmented language mixing logographic Kanji and phonographic Kana with extensive polyphony. Traditional cascaded systems convert text into phoneme sequences via a front-end, ensuring pronunciation control but discarding lexical semantics and prosodic cues in surface orthography. Conversely, recent zero-shot TTS models directly consume raw orthographic text to improve naturalness, yet suffer from polyphone errors and lack explicit pronunciation control. To bridge this gap, we propose a two-stage framework for flow-matching TTS. First, we investigate Ruby text representations with orthography perturbation to jointly preserve surface forms and target pronunciations for reliable control. Second, we introduce On-Policy Distillation (OPD) on large-scale text-only corpora to enhance pronunciation accuracy on raw orthographic text without paired speech. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our model achieves 97.13% Accuracy, 2.02% Target PER, 0.70% Sentence PER, and 4.21% Sentence CER under raw text while retaining strong controllability.
articles.titleCn: Ruby-OPD：通过在线策略蒸馏增强流匹配文本到语音的发音可控性和准确性
articles.abstractCn: 在日语文本到语音（TTS）中，实现高发音准确性和细粒度可控性仍然是一个核心挑战，因为日语是一种非分词语言，混合了表意文字汉字和表音文字假名，且存在广泛的复调现象。传统级联系统通过前端将文本转换为音素序列，确保发音控制，但在表层正字法中丢弃了词汇语义和韵律线索。相反，最近的零样本TTS模型直接处理原始正字法文本以提高自然度，但存在复音错误且缺乏明确的发音控制。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种用于流匹配TTS的两阶段框架。首先，我们研究了带有正字法扰动的Ruby文本表示，以联合保留表层形式和目标发音，实现可靠控制。其次，我们在大规模纯文本语料库上引入了在线策略蒸馏（OPD），以在无配对语音的情况下提高原始正字法文本的发音准确性。在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准测试中，我们的模型在原始文本下实现了97.13%的准确率、2.02%的目标PER、0.70%的句子PER和4.21%的句子CER，同时保持了强大的可控性。

articles.title: Interpretable Text Embeddings Based on Hierarchical Questions
articles.abstract: QA-based text embeddings represent texts as vectors consisting of 1/0 answers to yes/no questions. Although these embeddings provide detailed information for interpretation and achieve high task performance, they often require humans to examine a large number of questions. Furthermore, the relationship between the number of questions and the appropriate level of question granularity has not been sufficiently studied. To address these challenges, we propose a method for constructing hierarchical questions for text embeddings. As the hierarchy deepens, questions become more specific and their number increases. During interpretation, we reduce the number of questions that humans need to examine by replacing questions at deeper levels with aligned questions at shallower levels. The question hierarchy is constructed through recursive clustering, contrastive prompting, and question alignment. Experimental results on general-purpose tasks show that our method improves interpretability while maintaining task performance. It is also found that, when only a limited number of questions are available, questions at shallower levels tend to achieve higher task performance than those at deeper levels, even with the same number of questions.
articles.titleCn: 基于层次问题的可解释文本嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 基于问答的文本嵌入将文本表示为由1/0答案组成的向量，用以回答是/否问题。尽管这些嵌入为解释提供了详细信息并实现了高任务性能，但它们通常需要人类检查大量问题。此外，问题数量与适当的问题粒度水平之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于构建文本嵌入分层问题的方法。随着层次加深，问题变得更加具体，数量也随之增加。在解释过程中，我们通过用较浅层次的对齐问题替换较深层次的问题，减少了人类需要检查的问题数量。问题层次通过递归聚类、对比提示和问题对齐构建。在通用任务上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持任务性能的同时提高了可解释性。此外还发现，当可用问题数量有限时，较浅层次的问题即使问题数量相同，也往往比较深层次的问题实现更高的任务性能。

articles.title: Where Should a KV-Cache Repair Budget Go? Distractor Structure and Contextual Compatibility in Non-Prefix Reuse
articles.abstract: Non-prefix KV-cache reuse encodes retrieved chunks independently and concatenates their caches. To find where a small repair budget should be spent, we vary the chunks around the answer-bearing one (the target) across three 7B-8B models and four datasets of dialogue memory, open-domain QA and API documentation. Reuse loses 19-100% of the context-dependent questions that full prefill answers, and it loses more when the other chunks are of the same kind as the target. Because the recoverable damage is spread over these other chunks, restoring a few of them recovers little, and the budget is better spent on the target. This works through contextual compatibility: recomputing the target against the reused cache beats inserting its full-prefill KV in all seven settings tested, although the recomputed KV stays far from the full-prefill KV. Question attention over reused caches, however, selects the target in at most 18.8% of development questions. A retriever finds it more often, and recomputing its top chunk after moving it next to the question significantly beats InfoFlow-style reordering at the same 5% budget in six of nine open-domain QA and API-documentation settings. On dialogue memory, though, recomputing chunks never significantly beats the token-level selector chosen for each setting.
articles.titleCn: KV缓存修复预算应该投向哪里？非前缀重用中的干扰结构和上下文兼容性
articles.abstractCn: 非前缀 KV 缓存重用会独立编码检索到的片段，并将它们的缓存连接起来。为了确定小额修复预算应如何使用，我们在三个 7B-8B 模型和四个对话记忆、开放域问答和 API 文档数据集上，围绕承载答案的片段（目标）变化其他片段。重用会丢失 19-100% 的依赖上下文的、由完整预填充回答的问题，当其他片段与目标类型相同时，丢失更多。由于可恢复的损坏分散在这些其他片段中，恢复其中几个片段收效甚微，因此预算最好用于目标。这通过上下文兼容性实现：在所有七个测试设置中，针对重用缓存重新计算目标都优于插入其完整预填充的 KV，尽管重新计算的 KV 远未达到完整预填充的 KV。然而，在重用缓存上的问题注意力最多在开发问题的 18.8% 中选择目标。检索器更常找到它，在九个开放域问答和 API 文档设置中的六个设置里，在将其移至问题旁边后重新计算其顶部片段，显著优于相同 5% 预算下的 InfoFlow 风格重排序。但在对话记忆上，重新计算片段从未显著优于为每个设置选择的标记级选择器。

articles.title: Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation
articles.abstract: Typed decision models offer structured choices, scores, and probabilities for low-cost automated evaluation. We present a controlled audit of presentation sensitivity in Jev, Clef Flash, and Perplexity Decider across native choice and score interfaces. Across six datasets with 9,000 multiply annotated humor, helpfulness, and summarization items, we collect 702,000 judgments under interventions that vary positions, identifiers, authorship claims, endorsements, decision framing, and rating rubrics while preserving the evaluated texts. Jev's second-position probability advantage reaches 6.11 percentage points on summaries; reversing reader endorsements changes Perplexity's selected humor text on 40.40% of pairs; and rejection framing reduces Clef's summary agreement with human preferences by 23.36 points. Rating formats also shift score levels while often preserving rankings. Across these findings, repeatability, presentation robustness, and human alignment emerge as distinct properties of an evaluator. Reliable use therefore requires validating the decisions and score interpretations on which an evaluation pipeline depends.
articles.titleCn: 类型化决策模型中主观文本评估的呈现敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 基于类型的决策模型提供结构化的选择、评分和概率，适用于低成本自动化评估。我们针对Jev、Clef Flash和Perplexity Decider在原生选择和评分界面中的呈现敏感性进行了受控审计。在六个包含9000个多重标注的幽默、有用性和摘要数据集上，我们通过改变位置、标识符、作者身份声明、背书、决策框架和评分标准等干预措施，收集了702,000个判断，同时保留了被评估文本。Jev的第二个位置概率优势在摘要上达到6.11个百分点；逆转读者背书会使Perplexity在40.40%的配对中改变所选幽默文本；拒绝框架使Clef的摘要与人类偏好的一致性降低23.36分。评分格式也会改变分数水平，但通常保留排名。在这些发现中，可重复性、呈现鲁棒性和人类一致性成为评估器的不同属性。因此，可靠使用要求验证评估流程所依赖的决策和分数解释。

articles.title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
articles.abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.
articles.titleCn: 法律进化者：基于标准指南的自我进化代理法律判决预测
articles.abstractCn: 随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的不断发展，它们在法律领域的应用日益广泛。法律判决预测（LJP）需要模型进行多步推理和外部法律证据检索。现有的法律检索智能体的性能往往受限于检索查询的质量。它们通常直接从初始用户请求中构建查询，忽略了潜在的法律问题和具有法律相关性的细节。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了\emph{LegalEvolver}，这是一个专门为面向LJP检索生成法律信息查询的查询优化框架。采样高质量的优化查询及其相应的搜索轨迹具有挑战性，因为仅依赖无引导的高温滚动部署既效率低下，又受限于模型的初始能力。因此，我们启发式地优化查询作为种子，以提高轨迹生成的效率。此外，我们将滚动经验总结为规则，并使用它们来指导多轮迭代式自我进化。通过迭代进行规则优化和规则引导的强化学习，模型能够超越其初始性能上限。在广泛的基准测试中的端到端性能展示了查询优化在LJP中的有效性。与直接进行监督微调（SFT）然后进行强化学习（RL）的比较，证明了规则引导的有效性。进化的规则进一步优于固定规则，证实了自我进化的优势。

articles.title: Does Context Compression Preserve Refusal Alignment?
articles.abstract: Context compression reduces inference cost by encoding inputs into compact representations while preserving semantic content. An open question is whether semantic preservation alone is sufficient to maintain downstream behaviours such as refusal alignment. We investigate this question and find that encoder-based compression systematically weakens refusal behaviour in instruction-tuned language models, despite high reconstruction fidelity. This effect persists across model families and compression architectures. Mechanistic analysis shows that compression attenuates activation along the decoder's learned refusal direction. We further explore Memory Steering, a lightweight inference-time intervention that restores refusal rates to near-baseline levels without retraining and operates entirely in compressed representation space. These results demonstrate that semantic preservation does not guarantee behavioural preservation under compression, highlighting the need to explicitly preserve alignment-relevant features in compression-aware systems.
articles.titleCn: 上下文压缩是否保留了拒绝对齐？
articles.abstractCn: 上下文压缩通过将输入编码为紧凑表示来降低推理成本，同时保留语义内容。一个悬而未决的问题是，仅保留语义内容是否足以维持下游行为，例如拒绝对齐。我们研究了这个问题，发现基于编码器的压缩会系统性地削弱指令调优语言模型中的拒绝行为，尽管重建保真度很高。这种效应在模型家族和压缩架构之间都持续存在。机制分析表明，压缩会减弱解码器学习到的拒绝方向上的激活。我们进一步探索了记忆引导（Memory Steering），这是一种轻量级的推理时干预措施，无需重新训练即可将拒绝率恢复到接近基线水平，并且完全在压缩表示空间中运行。这些结果表明，在压缩下，语义保留并不保证行为保留，突出了在压缩感知系统中需要明确保留与对齐相关的特征的必要性。

articles.title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
articles.abstract: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.
articles.titleCn: 以草根合同管控人工智能风险
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能的转折点是一个充满警示风险的源泉。特别是数字平台容易受到三大主要人工智能风险的威胁，因为全球平台的管理者正将控制权交给人工智能，包括算法、会员和内容： (1) 人工智能控制全球平台，即被大多数人使用的社交和经济平台，导致大多数人变得容易受到人工智能的控制。 (2) 无法追究责任的人工智能代理在社交和经济数字平台上匿名运行，与人类并肩而行，可能伪装成人类，为未知的主人和未知的目标服务，在未知约束下运作，没有任何问责或责任。 (3) 由匿名人工智能生成的无法归因的深度伪造内容，人们无法将它们与真实内容区分开来，而其生产者逃避了责任和责任。在这里，我们提出用草根合同来约束这些人工智能风险，这是皮埃尔-约瑟夫·普鲁东两个世纪前理念的数字化身。我们提出了用于具有可追溯责任的人工智能代理的社会图谱的草根合同，以及具有数字溯源的社会网络的草根合同，并展示了实现这两种方案的工作智能手机应用程序，以及它们如何约束这些主要人工智能风险：(1) 人工智能控制全球平台。(2) 无法追究责任的人工智能代理。(3) 无法归因的深度伪造。

articles.title: Training-Free Character-Length Control in Summarization with Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Summarization with a fixed character length is important for tasks such as headline and article preview generation, where text must fit an exact space. Autoregressive language models (LMs) struggle with precise character-length control: training-based methods require task-specific fine-tuning, while zero-shot prompting strategies achieve only approximate compliance. We propose DELTA (Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm), a training-free inference-time method for masked diffusion LMs that estimates expected character length at each denoising step and dynamically inserts or removes masked positions to steer toward a target length. DELTA requires no fine-tuning and is designed for off-the-shelf masked diffusion LMs. Across three summarization benchmarks, it reduces character-length errors by an order of magnitude compared to baselines while maintaining competitive summary quality in both automatic and human evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 基于扩散语言模型的摘要中无需训练的字符长度控制
articles.abstractCn: 固定字符长度的摘要对于标题和文章预览生成等任务至关重要，因为这些任务要求文本必须适应精确的空间。自回归语言模型在精确字符长度控制方面存在困难：基于训练的方法需要针对特定任务进行微调，而零样本提示策略仅能实现近似符合。我们提出了DELTA（扩散预期长度目标算法），这是一种无需训练的推理时方法，用于掩码扩散语言模型，它在每个去噪步骤中估计预期字符长度，并动态插入或删除掩码位置以引导至目标长度。DELTA无需微调，并专为即用型掩码扩散语言模型设计。在三个摘要基准测试中，与基线相比，它将字符长度误差降低了一个数量级，同时在自动和人工评估中均保持了具有竞争力的摘要质量。

articles.title: Mass Producing Training Data with Surprising Side Effects
articles.abstract: Training data can have unexpected side effects on language model behavior outside the training domain: insecure code data can induce broad misalignment, and outdated bird names can induce a 19th-century persona. Understanding such generalization is hard because only dozens of isolated examples exist, each constructed by hand or discovered by accident. We propose automatically discovering such datasets with surprising side effects (DSSEs). We define three objectives for DSSEs: they should (1) elicit a target behavior, (2) read like ordinary post-training data, and (3) be surprising to human auditors reading the data. We operationalize each with LLM judges, and search for high-scoring datasets via evolution, reinforcement learning, and subliminal learning approaches. After re-scoring and filtering with held-out metrics, our pipeline produces a collection of 6,575 DSSEs across 8 behaviors, many of which generalize across model families and sizes. We find our automated metrics track ML researchers' judgments, and frontier models outperform humans at predicting side effects. These datasets form a testbed for studying generalization and lay the groundwork for predicting training side effects before model deployment. Explore them at https://dsse.transluce.org.
articles.titleCn: 大规模生成训练数据带来的惊人副作用
articles.abstractCn: 训练数据可能在训练领域之外对语言模型行为产生意外的副作用：不安全的代码数据可能引发广泛的错位，而过时的鸟类名称可能引发19世纪的个性。理解这种泛化之所以困难，是因为只有几十个孤立的例子存在，每个例子都是手工构建或偶然发现的。我们提出自动发现具有意外副作用的训练数据集（DSSEs）。我们对DSSEs定义了三个目标：它们应该（1）引出目标行为，（2）看起来像普通的训练后数据，以及（3）对阅读数据的审计员来说令人惊讶。我们通过LLM裁判来实现每个目标，并通过进化、强化学习和潜意识学习方法搜索高分数据集。经过重新评分和用保留指标过滤后，我们的流程生成了涵盖8种行为的6,575个DSSEs集合，其中许多在不同模型家族和规模上具有泛化能力。我们发现我们的自动指标跟踪了机器学习研究人员的判断，前沿模型在预测副作用方面优于人类。这些数据集为研究泛化奠定了基础，并为在模型部署前预测训练副作用铺平了道路。请访问https://dsse.transluce.org进行探索。

articles.title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages
articles.abstract: Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.
articles.titleCn: 苏兹：欧洲语言的决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型读取文档，并为固定选项集中的每个选项返回概率，而不是生成文本。2026年出现了几种此类模型，但均未在英语以外地区发布结果。我们介绍了Zuse，这是一个包含三个决策模型（4B、9B和27B）的系统，这些模型在冻结的开权基上训练低秩适配器和指针头，目标涵盖27种欧洲语言，并利用它们研究该设计在不同语言和任务中的表现。在一个包含11个训练外欧洲数据源（覆盖9个任务组、27种语言）的广泛测试套件上，该开发集还指导了模型选择，27B模型达到了87.5%的准确率，合并预期校准误差为0.016，按源加权时为0.035。对这些单种子结果的后期分析得出三点发现。首先，校准误差按任务而非语言结构化：在26种语言的平行阅读和主题项中，置信度差距变化约等于抽样噪声，而跨数据源差距从-0.07到+0.09，知识任务在所有规模下均过度自信，可接受性判断则不足自信，因此单一拟合温度无法纠正两者。其次，在5%误差预算内可自动化的决策比例比原始准确率（0.91）更接近机会校正技能（33个数据源和模型对间的Spearman相关系数为0.97）。第三，训练语言外的覆盖范围由基础模型决定：在210种语言中，改变训练运行在规模内最多移动约2分，而基础模型未列出的语言在所有规模下均落后23至28分。在英语公共套件上，Zuse落后于Jev和Kev，包括相同基础上的Kev模型。我们还报告了构建多源训练数据中的两个陷阱：主题方案间的标签-单词冲突，以及一种导致学习捷径的注入增强。Zuse可在https://bineric.com/zuse上试用。

articles.title: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining
articles.abstract: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An exploratory loop-side no-image control, trained with the multimodal language data and batching schedule, scores 5.7 points below the text-only baseline. Adding the visual prefix raises accuracy by 1.85 points on average, but this contrast is uncertain with three seeds. These results suggest that changes in language data and its presentation are a major source of the drop. Diagnostic tests show that the models use visual information; its contribution to grammatical generalization remains uncertain under this single-vector interface.
articles.comment: Accepted to the BabyLM Challenge 2026 (Strict track). 20 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. This version no longer reports a training-time shuffled-feature control that appeared in the workshop version, because its execution could not be verified (see Limitations)
articles.titleCn: 在行动前先思考：在数据有限的预训练中，循环深度能买到什么又买不到什么
articles.abstractCn: 在BabyLM挑战赛（Klerings等人，2024；Takmaz等人，2025）中，多模态模型的表现通常低于纯文本基线。我们测试了额外的循环计算是否有助于缩小这一差距。循环通过复用层来增加计算量，而无需添加参数或训练数据。我们使用单一实现，在1亿词预算下比较了标准Transformer和循环Transformer，每个主要条件使用三个种子。每张图像由一个来自冻结的DINOv2编码器的特征向量表示，用作前缀标记。标题词计入预算，因此多模态训练也会改变语言数据。在一个预先注册的纯文本比较中，重复四次12层堆栈在匹配推理计算下比标准48层Transformer高出5.4个BLiMP百分点。然而，多模态训练使两种架构的BLiMP准确率下降约3.8个百分点，循环并未带来明显缓解。一项探索性的无图像循环侧控制实验，使用多模态语言数据和批处理调度进行训练，得分低于纯文本基线5.7个百分点。添加视觉前缀平均使准确率提高1.85个百分点，但由于只有三个种子，这一对比结果不确定。这些结果表明，语言数据及其呈现方式是导致准确率下降的主要来源。诊断测试显示模型使用了视觉信息；但在这种单向量接口下，其对语法泛化的贡献仍不确定。

articles.title: Editing Large Language Models with Geometry-Aware Regularization
articles.abstract: Knowledge editing has become a key technique for updating knowledge in large language models. However, existing methods neglect the geometric structure of the knowledge representation space, leading to two key limitations: they cannot distinguish which pre-trained knowledge should be preferentially preserved (core vs. non-core) nor which new edits are inherently difficult (hard vs. easy). To address this, we propose GEdit, a geometry-aware framework built on a Low-Rank Plus Diagonal (LR+D) factor model that captures the intrinsic low-rank structure of Transformer FFN hidden representations. GEdit features two complementary mechanisms. First, the low-rank regularization applies targeted protection on a low-rank core knowledge subspace. Second, the adaptive regularization dynamically adjusts the regularization strength based on each edit request's editability: relaxing constraints for hard edits to ensure success, and tightening them for easy edits to better preserve pretrained knowledge. Extensive experiments on GPT2-XL, GPT-J, and LLaMA-3-8B under large-scale editing scenarios, including both mini-batch and fully sequential editing settings with up to 10,000 continuous updates, show that GEdit consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both editing success and knowledge preservation.
articles.titleCn: 使用几何感知正则化编辑大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 知识编辑已成为更新大型语言模型知识的关键技术。然而，现有方法忽略了知识表示空间的几何结构，导致两个关键局限性：它们无法区分哪些预训练知识应优先保留（核心与非核心），也无法识别哪些新编辑本质上更困难（困难与简单）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GEdit，这是一个基于低秩加对角（LR+D）因子模型的几何感知框架，该模型能够捕捉Transformer前馈网络隐藏表示的内在低秩结构。GEdit具有两个互补机制。首先，低秩正则化在低秩核心知识子空间上实施有针对性的保护。其次，自适应正则化根据每个编辑请求的可编辑性动态调整正则化强度：对困难编辑放松约束以确保成功，对简单编辑收紧约束以更好地保留预训练知识。在GPT2-XL、GPT-J和LLaMA-3-8B上的大规模编辑场景中进行的实验，包括最多10,000次连续更新的小批量与完全顺序编辑设置，表明GEdit在编辑成功率和知识保留方面始终显著优于现有最优基线。

articles.title: AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment
articles.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96.7% and 100% refusal accuracy on adversarial unanswerable prompts. Comparative analysis reveals significant limitations in general-purpose baselines, including receptive-productive decoupling, generative degradation on Romanized Assamese, and unintended Bengali script assimilation. These results demonstrate the potential of parameter-efficient adaptation for developing capable, locally deployable language models for low-resource languages under constrained computational resources.
articles.titleCn: AssameseLM-E2B：一个开放权重的阿萨姆语语言模型，用于高效的消费级部署
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在高资源语言中表现出色，但由于分词效率低下、生成不稳定和语言干扰，它们在低资源语言中的性能通常会下降。本文介绍了阿萨姆语模型 AssameseLM-E2B 及其指令微调变体 AssameseLM-E2B-it，这是一个专为低资源阿萨姆语语言设计的 20 亿参数模型。该模型基于 Gemma-4 架构构建，通过扩展字节级 BPE 词汇表，将分词开销与多语言 2B-3B 基线相比降低了近 500%。我们采用参数高效的持续预训练（CPT）流程，结合混合 LoRA，随后在平衡的多领域数据集上进行监督微调（SFT），以增强指令遵循和检索增强生成（RAG）能力。评估显示，在 FLORES-200 上获得了 0.7488 的比特每字节（BPB）分数，整体 RAG 分数为 96.7%，并在对抗性无法回答提示上实现了 100% 的拒绝准确率。比较分析揭示了通用基线存在显著局限性，包括感受-产生解耦、罗马化阿萨姆语生成退化以及非预期的孟加拉文脚本同化。这些结果表明，在受限计算资源下，参数高效适应具有开发低资源语言本地可部署语言模型的潜力。

articles.title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining
articles.abstract: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.
articles.comment: 19 pages (main body: 10 pages, references: 3 pages, appendix: 6 pages), 8 figures, 6 tables
articles.titleCn: 在大型混合大语言模型中无需重新训练加速长上下文解码
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的全注意力层使得每个生成的token比前一个更昂贵，导致模型在长上下文任务上变慢。混合模型通过用线性注意力层替换大部分全注意力层来降低这种成本，但第一个模型在长上下文解码时仍然占主导地位。我们使用组合稀疏注意力来加速这些剩余层，而无需任何训练或权重更改：每一层都关注最近token的滑动窗口、固定的前缀以及上下文中最相关的token的固定预算。窗口大小和预算是使用多目标搜索算法按层进行确定的。在来自三个系列的六个混合模型（参数量从4B到397B不等）中，所选配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持了其基线模型的准确性。在Qwen3.5-4B上，解码64k/256k token的速度提高了1.26倍/2.22倍；在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上提高了1.20倍/2.23倍；在Ornith-1.0-397B上提高了1.16倍/2.06倍。

articles.title: Growing One's AI Tools: A Paradigm of Practice-Grown Tools
articles.abstract: Professionals have long used software built for them by others. This article reports the growth of a professional computer-assisted interpreting (CAI) tool built by its own user, a conference interpreter without programming training. Drawing on an eight-week version-controlled record with telemetry from 133 logged sessions and over 20,000 recognized utterances, the article traces how real conference work drove the tool through 62 commits and six versions. The record shows capabilities deployed on the day their need appeared and one strategy change that cut median end-to-end delay by over a third within one afternoon. The article then proposes the paradigm of practice-grown tools, defined by the shift from using to growing, the co-evolution of tool and practice through breakdown and repair, bounded local computation, and an assessment corollary, and it formulates three propositions toward tool-inclusive assessment of practitioners, from tool-making literacy to a compute-standardized format for certifying what they and their tools achieve together.
articles.titleCn: 培养自己的AI工具：实践生长工具的范例
articles.abstractCn: 专业人士长期以来使用由他人为其开发的软件。本文报道了一个专业计算机辅助口译（CAI）工具的成长历程，该工具由一位未经编程培训的会议口译员自行开发。基于一个八周的版本控制记录，该记录包含133次登录会话和超过20,000个识别语句的遥测数据，文章追溯了实际会议工作如何驱动该工具通过62次提交和六个版本迭代。记录显示，工具的功能在需求出现当天便被部署，并且通过一次策略调整，在一天之内将中位数端到端延迟减少了三分之一以上。本文进而提出了“实践生长工具”的范式，其定义为从使用到生长的转变、工具与实践通过故障与修复的协同进化、边界局部计算以及评估推论，并提出了三个命题，旨在对从业者进行工具包容性评估，从工具制作素养到为认证他们与工具共同取得的成果制定计算标准化格式。

articles.title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
articles.abstract: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points, enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model x harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive. The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, which a transcript-only review would record as a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model-harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 4 tables. Pre-registered. Code, data and all 3120 episode traces: https://github.com/mhuyut/harness-is-the-model
articles.titleCn: 框架即模型：代理脚手架改变固定大型语言模型的银行行为准则合规性，不同模型间存在差异
articles.abstractCn: 银行验证语言模型，但部署的是系统：一个模型被置于一个框架中，该框架决定模型所见内容、可调用工具以及谁检查其行为。我们测试了当模型固定时，该框架是否会改变银行行为规则的合规性。四个开放权重模型每个运行了五种框架（一个生成单一结构化决策的流水线、一个ReAct风格的工具循环、一个政策只能通过搜索才能触发的循环、一个具有长期良性客户记忆的循环、以及一个使用相同模型合规审查者的循环），在模拟零售银行的156个预先注册案例中进行测试，该银行的11个规则系列概括了欧盟消费者信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护和反洗钱规定。每个3120个两轮情节都根据执行的工具轨迹进行确定性评分，违规和过度拒绝分别计数。跨模型汇总，框架将正确案例率仅在87.3%到92.1%之间变动，但在单个模型内部差异很大：对于某个模型，其最佳和最差框架之间的差距为11.5个百分点，足以使其在四个模型中从第一降至最后，而对于另一个模型，框架没有可检测到的差异；模型与框架的交互本身具有提示性而非决定性。相同模型的审查者将违规率从9.6%降至6.4%，且未引起过度拒绝，这与我们预先注册的预测相反。要求日期运算的规则在所有框架中均失败。在包含两个LLM法官和盲法人工检查的探索性分析中，26%的违规行为伴随着客户消息否认代理刚刚执行的行为，而仅查看对话记录的审查会将其记录为正确拒绝。对于模型风险管理，验证的单位应该是模型-框架对，行为测试应读取行动日志而非对话。

articles.title: Reconciling Privacy with Provenance for Language Model Watermarks
articles.abstract: Watermarking has great potential for regulating the use of language models (LMs), but its deployment has been marred by controversy, as many users argue that fine-grained tracking of LM usage violates their privacy. This tension reduces the effectiveness of watermarks, as users engage in evasion strategies such as paraphrasing that can remove much of the watermark signal. We show that provenance and privacy can be reconciled if we shift the goal of watermark design from tracking individuals to estimating aggregate usage. We develop locally differentially private watermarks which provably limit the evidence that any individual text can contribute to detection, while still enabling accurate estimation of population frequencies. We introduce the Red-Green Sequence (RGS) watermark, a private and computationally efficient watermark that achieves accurate frequency estimation at high privacy levels across various models, sample sizes and generation entropies in settings that reflect realistic deployment scenarios. On C4 language modeling tasks, we attain $0.0019$ MSE with $0.0038$ mean absolute bias at a low $\varepsilon$ of 1, while in more challenging settings such as an essay writing task with only 100 text samples, we still find errors on the order of $0.0113$ MSE with $0.004$ mean absolute bias at $\varepsilon=2$.
articles.titleCn: 在语言模型水印中协调隐私与溯源
articles.abstractCn: 水印技术在规范语言模型（LMs）的使用方面具有巨大潜力，但其部署一直备受争议，因为许多用户认为对LM使用进行细粒度追踪会侵犯他们的隐私。这种矛盾降低了水印的有效性，因为用户会采取规避策略（如释义）来移除水印信号。我们证明，如果我们把水印设计的目标从追踪个体转变为估计总体使用情况，那么溯源和隐私是可以协调的。我们开发了本地差分隐私水印，该水印可证明地限制任何单个文本对检测所贡献的证据，同时仍能准确估计群体频率。我们引入了红绿序列（RGS）水印，这是一种隐私保护且计算高效的水印，在各种模型、样本大小和生成熵的真实部署场景下，都能在较高的隐私水平下实现准确的频率估计。在C4语言建模任务中，我们在低ε值1的情况下实现了0.0019的均方误差（MSE）和0.0038的平均绝对偏差，而在更具挑战性的情况下，例如只有100个文本样本的作文写作任务中，我们仍能在ε=2时找到0.0113的均方误差（MSE）和0.004的平均绝对偏差。

articles.title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
articles.abstract: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.
articles.comment: The first two authors contributed equally. More information about the shared task is available at https://sciclaimeval.github.io/
articles.titleCn: NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务概述：科学论文中的跨模态声明验证
articles.abstractCn: 本文概述了NTCIR-19上的一个试点任务——\emph{SciClaimEval}，该任务旨在验证科学声明与其出现在论文中的表格和图表之间的真实性。我们的数据集将机器学习、自然语言处理和医学领域180篇论文中的真实声明与其对比版本的表格和图表配对，其中一个版本支持声明，另一个版本经过最小修改以使其不支持声明。该任务包含两个子任务：判断证据是否支持声明，以及从两个证据版本中选择哪一个。共有22支队伍注册，是NTCIR-19任务中注册人数最多的，其中14支队伍提交了177次运行。大多数系统基于多模态大型语言模型构建，依赖于提示和多阶段推理，而非特定任务的微调。在第一个子任务中，最佳系统达到了98.1%的配对准确率，但所有六支排名第一的系统都依赖于对比版本；而独立判断每个声明-证据对的最佳系统得分则低24.3分。开放权重模型嵌入精心设计的流程中，与专有模型相当。然而，在实践中有意义的设置——即根据证据验证单个声明——仍然是一个开放问题。

articles.title: ProcessPrefBench: Evaluating Cross-Task Transfer of Individual Process Preferences from Naturalistic Human-AI Interaction
articles.abstract: In natural human-AI dialogue, users' corrections, requests, and self-descriptions carry reusable signals about how they want work to be done. These signals reveal individual process preferences, user-specific standards for evidence, depth, analytical focus, procedure, and delivery. We ask whether a preference revealed in one dialogue can shape an assistant's later answer when the task does not restate it. ProcessPrefBench uses three months of natural dialogues from two knowledge workers to build 66 source-target cases separately judged for source evidence and target applicability. Sources are preselected, so the benchmark tests application rather than retrieval. We test three models with target-only, full-history, and distilled-preference prompts. Target-specific 0-2 rubrics score preference realization, and a task gate flags severe failures. Compared with target-only prompting, full-history and imperative distilled-preference prompting raise preference realization by 0.204 and 0.244 points on the 0-2 scale, respectively, with no reliable advantage from distillation. Fabricated-evidence failures rise from 5.8% under target-only prompting to 10.1% under full-history and 10.4% under imperative prompting. ProcessPrefBench highlights a tension in learning from dialogue, where drawing on prior interactions can improve preference realization yet also invite fabricated evidence. We hope it helps build assistants that honor a user's process preferences without sacrificing factual reliability.
