articles.titleCn: ProcessPrefBench：评估自然人类-AI交互中个体过程偏好的跨任务迁移
articles.abstractCn: 在自然的人机对话中，用户的纠正、请求和自我描述包含了关于他们希望如何完成工作的可重用信号。这些信号揭示了个人流程偏好、特定于用户的证据标准、深度、分析焦点、程序和交付方式。我们探讨了在任务未重申的情况下，一个对话中揭示的偏好是否能够塑造助手后续的回答。ProcessPrefBench利用两位知识工作者三个月的自然对话，构建了66个源目标案例，这些案例分别被独立判断为源证据和目标适用性。源案例是预先筛选的，因此该基准测试的是应用能力而非检索能力。我们测试了三种模型：仅目标提示、完整历史记录提示和精炼偏好提示。目标特定0-2评分标准用于评估偏好实现情况，任务门禁用于标记严重错误。与仅目标提示相比，完整历史记录提示和命令式精炼偏好提示分别在0-2量表上使偏好实现度提高了0.204和0.244分，但精炼并未带来可靠优势。虚构证据错误率从仅目标提示下的5.8%上升到完整历史记录提示下的10.1%和命令式提示下的10.4%。ProcessPrefBench突显了从对话中学习时存在的矛盾，即参考先前交互可以提高偏好实现度，但也可能引入虚构证据。我们希望它能帮助构建那些尊重用户流程偏好且不失事实可靠性的助手。

articles.title: Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding
articles.abstract: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pretraining, while its multiple-choice answers stayed near chance and its English MMLU fell by 7.6 points. We report 15 trained models and their 5 starting models from June to October 2025, scored in 2026 on one harness with paired intervals, and we report what went wrong: lost training records, a thinking-mode dataset with almost no reasoning in it, later branches whose training data was never documented, and a 4-bit release that contains no transformer layers.
articles.titleCn: 将Qwen3模型从0.6B扩展到8B以适配塔吉克语：文本损失降低并不意味着理解能力提升
articles.abstractCn: 在塔吉克语新闻和书籍上训练的小型LoRA适配器，在0.6B到8B的各个规模下，均降低了Qwen3的塔吉克语文本损失，每token降低了0.60至1.45纳特，但它们中没有任何一个提高了塔吉克语阅读理解能力（在可测量的范围内）。在Belebele上，1.7B和8B适配器未改变准确率，而4B适配器降低了3.7个百分点；在0.6B时，分数上升了4.2个百分点，但接近随机水平，且与模型偏好的答案字母变化一致，因此我们不将其视为理解。在8B时，通过在约3.75亿个原始塔吉克语文本上进行持续预训练，Belebele分数提升了9.9个百分点。在进一步的监督微调阶段后，我们的主模型e3在Belebele上比Qwen3-8B高出11.4个百分点；其英语MMLU降低了1.2个百分点，且排除了损失超过3.3个百分点的可能性。相同的重配方应用于Qwen3-0.6B-Base，在仅使用书籍进行预训练后，其文本损失接近8B模型，但其选择题答案仍接近随机水平，英语MMLU降低了7.6个百分点。我们报告了2025年6月至10月训练的15个模型及其5个起始模型，这些模型于2026年在一个配对间隔的测试框架下进行评分，并报告了出错之处：丢失的训练记录、一个几乎不含推理的思维模式数据集、未记录训练数据的后期分支，以及一个不包含Transformer层的4位发布版本。

articles.title: SVGFaith: A Two-Layer Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Text-to-SVG Generation
articles.abstract: Text-to-SVG systems are commonly evaluated by applying raster-image metrics to rasterised outputs, yet whether these scores capture fine-grained prompt faithfulness remains unclear. We introduce SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework in which the more faithful candidate of each pair is determined by construction or by human judgment. SVGFaith-Diagnostic contains 1,842 controlled contrastive pairs across eight capability axes, split evenly between two directions: two renderings compared against one prompt, and two descriptions compared against one rendering. SVGFaith-Arena contains 1,327 human-annotated comparisons of real generator outputs. On SVGFaith-Diagnostic, CLIP and three other image--text embedding metrics reach at least 0.789 pairwise accuracy on object identity but at most 0.672 on spatial relations and attribute binding, where chance is 0.5. We further introduce SVGFaith-Score, an interpretable pointwise metric. A domain-tuned decomposer turns each prompt into a dependency graph of atomic visual requirements, a visual question answering model scores whether each requirement is satisfied, and a requirement's score is discounted when its prerequisites score low. In addition to the overall score, the per-requirement scores show which requirements are judged unsatisfied and which inherit discounts from their prerequisites. SVGFaith-Score significantly outperforms all nine baselines, including a Qwen3.5-122B-A10B judge, on Arena and in both Diagnostic directions. Code and data: https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith.
articles.titleCn: SVGFaith：针对文本到SVG生成中忠实度指标的双层元评估
articles.abstractCn: 文本到SVG系统通常通过将光栅图像指标应用于光栅化输出进行评估，但这些分数是否能够捕捉到细粒度的提示忠实度尚不清楚。我们引入了SVGFaith，这是一个双层元评估框架，其中每对中的更忠实候选者是通过构建或人工判断确定的。SVGFaith-Diagnostic包含1,842个受控对比对，分布在八个能力轴上，平均分为两个方向：两个渲染结果与一个提示进行比较，以及两个描述与一个渲染结果进行比较。SVGFaith-Arena包含1,327个人工标注的真实生成器输出比较。在SVGFaith-Diagnostic上，CLIP和另外三个图像-文本嵌入指标在对象身份上达到至少0.789的成对准确率，但在空间关系和属性绑定上最多为0.672，而随机概率为0.5。我们进一步引入了SVGFaith-Score，这是一种可解释的点式指标。一个领域调谐的分解器将每个提示转换为原子视觉需求的依赖图，一个视觉问答模型评分每个需求是否得到满足，当需求的前置条件得分低时，该需求的得分会被折减。除了总分之外，每个需求的得分显示了哪些需求被判断为不满足，以及哪些需求继承了前置条件的折减。在Arena上以及在两个Diagnostic方向上，SVGFaith-Score显著优于所有九个基线，包括一个Qwen3.5-122B-A10B裁判。代码和数据：https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith。

articles.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
articles.abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.
articles.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code and model weights available at https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2
articles.titleCn: 孔夫子4-R2T2：一种用于实时转录的稳定前缀流式语音识别模型
articles.abstractCn: 流式语音识别正越来越多地被翻译器和语音代理等机器所使用，这些机器对每个出现的标记进行处理。如果一个后续被修改的标记会导致工作浪费或错误操作。在这项工作中，我们提出了Confucius4-R2T2（全称Real Real-Time Transcription），一种稳定前缀流式ASR模型，它在保持高精度和低延迟的同时，永远不会修改其早期输出。R2T2是通过在后训练阶段对1500小时的中文和英文音频上的Qwen3-ASR-1.7B进行微调得到的，同时冻结其预训练的音频编码器和投影器。这种适应基于我们在这项工作中引入的新概念——最长稳定前缀（LSP）。我们证明了LSP在前缀顺序下是单调的，与全音频输出一致，并且在等于早期完整输出的标签中是最大的。通过学习LSP标签，可以将全上下文模型转换为稳定前缀流式模型，而无需任何架构上的改变。广泛的评估表明，R2T2将流式识别的质量接近于基础模型的完整上下文质量，同时以低发射延迟提供稳定的文本输出。其优势不仅限于后训练语言，展示了从完整上下文ASR到稳定流式的一条实用路径。我们在https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2和https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2上开源了模型权重和代码。

articles.title: When Every Choice Is Correct: A Causal Study of Numerical Preference in Language Models
articles.abstract: When a language model chooses a number between 1 and 30, every integer in the range is valid, yet the model can favor particular answers. We use numerical choice to study how preference is processed across layers and tokens. Perturbation probing and gradient attribution nominate neurons for activation interventions. In a selected Qwen3-4B case, a pre-answer edit changes 17 to 15 while both runs first emit 1. After the edit ends, selective cache and attention-output replacements trace part of its continuing influence on the second digit. Replacing one attention head's output or the other heads' outputs jointly produces similar immediate readout contributions; both interventions restore 17 but have different final log-odds effects on 7 versus 5. Holding later multilayer perceptron (MLP) outputs at their values from the edited run without either replacement reduces this effect gap from 0.119 to 0.0025 nat. Later computation therefore changes how similar local contributions affect the continuation. Retrospective estimates across eighteen contexts capture much of the probability movement but miss the selected answer switch. Prompt tests also separate influence from answer changes: one held-out prompt retains influence without switching, and only one of twelve fresh wordings qualifies for the reader/MLP test; there, joint MLP clamping again reduces the gap between the two reader effects while the answer remains 17. These results use numerical choice as a controlled case for studying persistent state and conditional downstream processing; they do not establish the origin or a complete circuit of natural numerical preference.
articles.titleCn: 当每个选择都是正确的：语言模型中数值偏好的因果研究
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型在1到30之间选择一个数字时，范围内的每个整数都是有效的，但模型可能会偏爱特定的答案。我们使用数值选择来研究偏好如何在层和标记之间进行处理。扰动探测和梯度归因提名了用于激活干预的神经元。在一个选定的Qwen3-4B案例中，一个预答案编辑将17更改为15，而两次运行首先都发出1。编辑结束后，选择性缓存和注意力输出替换追踪了其对第二个数字的部分持续影响。替换一个注意力头的输出或联合替换其他头的输出会产生相似的即时读数贡献；这两种干预都恢复了17，但对7相对于5的最终对数几率效应不同。保持后期多层感知器（MLP）输出的值与编辑运行相同，且不进行任何替换，将这种效应差距从0.119减少到0.0025 nat。因此，后期计算改变了相似局部贡献如何影响延续的方式。回顾性估计跨越十八个上下文捕捉了大部分概率变化，但遗漏了选定答案的切换。提示测试也区分了影响与答案变化：一个保留的提示保持了影响而不切换，而只有十二个新表述中的一个合格用于读者/MLP测试；在那里，联合MLP钳位再次减少了两种读者效应之间的差距，而答案仍然是17。这些结果使用数值选择作为一个受控案例来研究持续状态和条件下游处理；它们并未确立自然数值偏好的起源或一个完整的电路。

articles.title: Who Pays for the Knowledge Models Copy? Model Collapse as Rogers' Paradox
articles.abstract: Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the loop, and the theory of model collapse treats that supply as given: a fixed archive, drawn from a fixed distribution. We argue that the supply is the problem, and that cultural evolution has the theory of it. We read model collapse as Rogers' paradox: a population that comes to rely on copying ends up no better off than one that never copied, because copies go stale unless someone keeps learning for themselves. We test the identification in three steps. First, Rogers' model, fitted only to fully synthetic training, predicts to within a few percentage points how much rare knowledge language models, from word trigrams to a pretrained transformer, retain under other mixtures of fresh data. Second, when the world itself changes, a lineage that copies its own past needs more fresh data to keep up the faster the world changes, as Rogers' model says it must and as analyses that assume a fixed target cannot; a lineage that restarts every generation from fixed pretrained weights is largely insulated, because those weights are knowledge that is never copied. Third, we close the loop: when the people who write a model's training data can ask the model instead of finding things out, the supply of fresh data becomes endogenous. At equilibrium, the model is exactly as reliable as it is costly for people to find out for themselves, the population is no better off than without the model, and every increase in the share of model-written text must be paid for by more people learning for themselves. Users who check what they are told and relearn when it is wrong break the paradox. Filters that select plausible text are conformist and accelerate collapse; only checks that carry new information act as critical learning.
articles.titleCn: 谁为知识模型副本买单？模型坍塌作为罗杰斯悖论
articles.abstractCn: 在早期模型输出上训练的生成模型会逐代丢失知识，首先是稀有知识。所有有效的补救措施都引入了循环外部的信息，而模型崩溃理论将这种供应视为既定：一个固定的档案，源自一个固定的分布。我们认为供应才是问题，而文化进化对此有理论解释。我们将模型崩溃解读为罗杰斯悖论：一个依赖复制的群体最终与从未复制过的群体一样没有改善，因为复制会过时，除非有人持续自我学习。我们分三步验证这一识别。首先，仅适用于完全合成训练的罗杰斯模型，能以百分之几的精度预测语言模型（从词三元组到预训练的Transformer）在其他新鲜数据混合下保留多少稀有知识。其次，当世界本身发生变化时，复制自己过去的谱系需要更多新鲜数据来跟上世界变化的步伐，正如罗杰斯模型所预测的那样，而固定目标假设的分析却做不到；从固定预训练权重每代重新开始的谱系则基本不受影响，因为这些权重是不会被复制的知识。第三，我们闭环：当撰写模型训练数据的人可以询问模型而不是自己寻找信息时，新鲜数据的供应就内生化了。在均衡状态下，模型的可靠性与其对人类自身查找信息成本成正比，群体在没有模型的情况下也没有更好，并且每增加模型编写文本的份额都必须由更多人自我学习来支付。检查所被告知内容并在错误时重新学习的人打破了这一悖论。选择看似合理的文本的过滤器是遵循习俗的，并加速崩溃；只有携带新信息的检查才起到批判性学习的作用。

articles.title: Holistic Parallel Supervision for Expressive Speech to Speech Translation
articles.abstract: Expressiveness is central to speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), yet existing datasets rarely align source and target speech jointly in content, prosody, timing, and speaker identity. Consequently, current systems often rely on indirect conditioning or transfer mechanisms. To obtain this supervision, we introduce a training-data construction strategy that combines professional dubbing, which provides human-performed correspondence in content, prosody, and timing, with multilingual voice conversion to reduce speaker mismatch. We evaluate this supervision using existing expressive S2ST systems and DirectS2ST, an end-to-end method developed in this work that predicts the complete target-speech representation directly from source speech. Experiments on English-German and English-Spanish show that holistic parallel supervision improves expressive realization across all evaluated systems. DirectS2ST exhibits the largest gains in content, prosody, timing, speaker similarity, and human-rated expressiveness. To our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic investigation of holistic parallel supervision for expressive S2ST.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
articles.titleCn: 表达性语音到语音翻译的全面并行监督
articles.abstractCn: 表现力对于语音到语音翻译（S2ST）至关重要，但现有的数据集很少在内容、韵律、时序和说话人身份上联合对齐源语言和目标语言。因此，当前系统通常依赖间接条件或迁移机制。为了获得这种监督，我们引入了一种训练数据构建策略，该策略结合了专业配音（提供人类执行的内容、韵律和时序对应关系）和多语言语音转换以减少说话人不匹配。我们使用现有的表现力S2ST系统以及本工作中开发端到端方法DirectS2ST（直接从源语音预测完整目标语音表示）来评估这种监督。在英语-德语和英语-西班牙语上的实验表明，整体并行监督提高了所有评估系统在表现力实现方面的能力。DirectS2ST在内容、韵律、时序、说话人相似性和人类评价的表现力方面表现出最大的增益。据我们所知，这项工作首次系统地研究了整体并行监督在表现力S2ST中的应用。

articles.title: Familiar letters, not related languages, let unseen languages into a shared space of meaning
articles.abstract: Hundreds of languages have written text but almost no translations, and whether a model learning one from untranslated text builds on a related language or familiar letters is unclear: they usually coincide. Here we show that familiar letters, not a related language, let an unseen language into a shared space of meaning. GlyphMind, a tokenizer-free vision transformer that reads text as pixels and lets any sentence be shown in any script, was pretrained to align translations across 27 writing systems. Adapted on untranslated Lao, a language and script it had never seen, it retrieved English translations seven times as often as the strongest simple baseline. Rewritten in unfamiliar letters, Lao did not enter although its close relative Thai was in pretraining; Santali, which had none, entered in Devanagari, familiar from Hindi, but not in its own script. Transliteration into familiar scripts may thus open multilingual models to languages without translations.
articles.titleCn: 家书，而非相关语言，让未见过的语言进入共享的意义空间
articles.abstractCn: 数百种语言拥有书面文字，但几乎没有任何翻译，而一个模型从未翻译的文本中学习时，它究竟是建立在相关语言之上还是熟悉的字母上尚不明确：它们通常是一致的。在这里，我们表明，是熟悉的字母而非相关语言，让一种未见过语言进入共享的意义空间。GlyphMind是一种无分词器视觉Transformer，它将文本视为像素，并允许任何句子以任何文字形式显示，它被预训练以对齐27种书写系统的翻译。在它从未见过的一种未翻译的老挝语上应用，它检索英语翻译的频率比最强的简单基线高七倍。当用不熟悉的字母重写时，老挝语没有进入，尽管它的近亲泰语在预训练中出现过；没有任何近亲的桑塔利语，在来自印地语的熟悉的天城文脚本中进入，但不在自己的脚本中。因此，将文字转写为熟悉的脚本可能会让多语言模型接触到没有翻译的语言。

articles.title: How Far Can You Steer? Behavior-Capability Frontiers in Contrastive Activation Addition
articles.abstract: Activation steering can modify language-model behavior without parameter updates, but behavioral efficacy alone does not determine whether an intervention is usable. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) steers targeted behaviors using activation directions derived from contrasting examples, potentially degrading unrelated model capabilities in the process. We therefore study CAA through a behavior-capability frontier, selecting interventions that maximize behavioral gain subject to an explicit bound on capability degradation. We evaluate this framework across four instruction-tuned models, seven behaviors, and capability-loss budgets of 1%, 3%, and 5% (absolute percentage points). Validation-selected behavioral effects generalize strongly to held-out data ($ρ= 0.945$), while joint behavior-capability survival among nonzero operating points rises from 37.5% at the 1% budget to 72.7% at 3%, with limited additional improvement at 5%. Control experiments indicate that these effects depend on learned behavior directions rather than generic activation perturbations. Representational geometry is significantly but only modestly predictive of causal cross-behavior transfer. Finally, secondary capability, out-of-distribution, and open-ended evaluations show that interventions satisfying protected benchmarks can still degrade untested capabilities or transfer unevenly to free-form generation. These results characterize activation steering as a constrained intervention whose usable range depends on model, behavior, direction, layer, and evaluation budget, rather than a universal control knob.
articles.titleCn: 你能转向多远？对比激活相加的行为能力边界
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导可以在不更新参数的情况下修改语言模型的行为，但行为效能本身并不能决定干预是否可用。对比激活添加（CAA）通过对比示例导出的激活方向来引导目标行为，但在这个过程中可能会降低无关模型能力。因此，我们通过行为能力边界研究CAA，选择在能力退化有明确限制的前提下最大化行为收益的干预措施。我们在四个指令微调模型、七种行为以及1%、3%和5%（绝对百分点）的能力损失预算下评估该框架。验证选择的行为效果在未见数据上具有很强的泛化能力（$ρ= 0.945$），而联合行为能力在非零运行点中的存活率从1%预算的37.5%提升到3%的72.7%，在5%时仅有有限的进一步改善。控制实验表明，这些效果依赖于学习到的行为方向，而非通用的激活扰动。表征几何学在因果关系跨行为转移中具有显著但仅适度的预测性。最后，次要能力、分布外和开放式评估表明，满足保护基准的干预措施仍可能降低未测试的能力或在不同自由生成中不均匀迁移。这些结果将激活引导描述为一种受限干预，其可用范围取决于模型、行为、方向、层级和评估预算，而非通用的控制旋钮。

articles.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
articles.abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. Our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. SimpleHC incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. It maintains performance comparable to mHC when scaling from 15B to 30B MoE models, exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training, and remains stable under stress. We hope SimpleHC will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design, making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.
articles.titleCn: 超连接的设计：简化、稳定与可扩展性
articles.abstractCn: 超连接（HC）架构在前沿语言模型中日益被采用，但其组件理解不足且引入了不可忽视的训练开销。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了HC架构，以理解其组件并识别更简单、更高效的设计。我们发现，无混合的 learned read/write gating 和固定门的非约束混合形成了两个有效的交互组：单独使用任何一组都能达到与 mHC 相当的性能。我们还发现，即使没有混合，对扩展残差状态的重复访问也是训练开销的主要来源。这些发现促成了 SimpleHC 的出现，该架构通过移除残差混合并简化执行（通过共享内存访问），利用由此产生的加性结构和共享门输入来简化设计。特定层门共享一个组入口状态，支持批量读取和延迟写入；标量校正精确地保留了前一个子层的输出贡献。我们的分析支持保留的残差结构以及共享内存访问的设计。在最大测试规模下，SimpleHC 仅比普通的残差基线增加了 2.4% 的端到端训练时间。当从 15B 扩展到 30B 的 MoE 模型时，SimpleHC 保持了与 mHC 相当的性能，在标准训练期间表现出更平滑的梯度动态，并在压力下保持稳定。我们希望 SimpleHC 能鼓励在基础模型设计中更广泛地追求简洁，使性能提升在规模上更具可及性和实用性。

articles.title: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
articles.abstract: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. In the model rationales, the delivery robot appears as a physical obstacle, whereas the humanoid appears as either a threat or a source of protection. Like humans, both models chose robots more often at night, but chose the humanoid over the delivery robot far less often, and Gemma showed a night effect for the humanoid about three times that of humans. These results show that the effect of a robot on perceived safety depends on when it appears, and that persona-conditioned MLLMs capture only part of human judgments.
articles.titleCn: 城市中的机器人：基于角色的城市机器人认知
articles.abstractCn: 行人越来越多地在城市公共空间中遇到机器人，但机器人如何改变街道的感知安全度尚不清楚。我们研究了机器人的存在和类型如何影响不同城市环境中的感知安全度。我们生成了18张首尔街道的图片，这些图片在一天中的时间、道路等级和机器人状态（无机器人、配送机器人或人形机器人）上有所不同。两个多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs），Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma4-26B，每个模型都基于500个合成人物进行条件化，在每对图片中选择更安全的图片，而25名人类受访者也完成了相同的任务。两个模型都倾向于选择没有机器人的街道，并且更倾向于选择配送机器人而非人形机器人。机器人在夜间被选中的频率更高，而老年人选中的频率较低，而道路等级的影响较小。在模型推理中，配送机器人被视为物理障碍，而人形机器人则被视为威胁或保护来源。与人类一样，两个模型在夜间更频繁地选择机器人，但远不如人类频繁地选择人形机器人优于配送机器人，而Gemma对人形机器人的夜间效应大约是人类的三倍。这些结果表明，机器人对感知安全度的影响取决于其出现的时间，而基于人物条件的MLLMs只捕捉了人类判断的一部分。

articles.title: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to scale capacity efficiently, but expert parameters dominate memory even though only a few experts are activated per token: they account for over 90% of model size in modern MoE-MLLMs (e.g., 54 GB out of about 58 GB in BF16 for InternVL3.5-30B-A3B and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B). Expert pruning has emerged as an effective compression strategy, but existing methods aggregate importance uniformly across tokens, ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles for vision versus language processing. To address this, we propose MAEP (Modality-Aware Expert Pruning), a training-free framework that decomposes expert importance by modality in a single forward pass. MAEP introduces (1) Delta-H Output ($ΔH$), a redistribution-aware metric measuring the MoE output change when an expert is removed, and (2) low-attention vision tokens as a vision-side pruning signal that is dataset-stable: its expert-importance ranking remains stable across different datasets. Text-side importance serves as a preservation signal while vision-side importance serves as a pruning signal, and experts are ranked globally across layers. Experiments on three MoE-based MLLMs across multimodal and text benchmarks show that MAEP outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on the majority of multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text-only tasks, reducing the BF16 expert weight footprint by about 27 GB (about 47% of total memory) so that the full weight footprint of an approximately 58 GB model fits within a single 40 GB GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/nota-github/MAEP.
articles.titleCn: 模态感知专家剪枝技术用于基于MoE的多模态大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）使多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够高效地扩展容量，但即使每个标记只激活少数专家，专家参数仍主导内存：在现代MoE-MLLM中（例如，InternVL3.5-30B-A3B和Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B在BF16中的约58 GB中占54 GB），专家剪枝已成为一种有效的压缩策略，但现有方法在标记上统一聚合重要性，忽略了同一专家可能在视觉处理和语言处理中扮演不同角色。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MAEP（模态感知专家剪枝），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过单次前向传递按模态分解专家重要性。MAEP引入了（1）Delta-H输出（$ΔH$），一种感知重分配的指标，用于衡量移除专家时MoE输出的变化，以及（2）低注意力视觉标记作为视觉侧剪枝信号，该信号具有数据集稳定性：其专家重要性排名在不同数据集上保持稳定。文本侧重要性作为保留信号，而视觉侧重要性作为剪枝信号，专家在所有层中进行全局排名。在三个基于MoE的MLLM上进行的跨多模态和文本基准测试表明，MAEP在大多数多模态基准测试中优于模态无关基线，同时在纯文本任务上保持竞争力，将BF16专家权重占用减少约27 GB（约占总内存的47%），使得一个约58 GB模型的完整权重占用可以在单个40 GB GPU内。代码可在https://github.com/nota-github/MAEP获取。

articles.title: Routes of Reasoning: Reading and Reshaping Test-Time Compute in MoE Models
articles.abstract: Reasoning models allocate test-time compute across distinct behaviors such as planning, deriving, and verifying. However, models frequently "overthink," continuing to verify and re-derive long after finding a correct answer. This wastes expensive compute and can even degrade performance. Existing interventions, such as token budgets or steering, primarily regulate reasoning duration rather than targeting specific behaviors. In this work, we demonstrate that Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers provide a natural, training-free interface for behavioral control. We first split reasoning traces into sentence-level segments and label each with one of six reasoning behaviors (planning, execution, restatement, fact, reflection, and conclusion), so that every token carries the behavior of its segment. Linear probes on router logits predict this label nearly as well as probes on the residual stream, the model's full hidden state and the standard target for probing, while using about half as many features. These signals generalize: experts associated with a reasoning behavior on one dataset predict the same behavior on the others, across six datasets spanning five domains (math, code, science, knowledge, and commonsense). Building on this, we selectively edit expert router scores during inference to curb overthinking. Across four models and four benchmarks, this intervention reduces the number of generated tokens by a median of 30.4% (and up to 63.3%). Crucially, it encourages the model to stop once the problem is solved, rather than skipping essential reasoning steps. Accuracy never drops by more than 0.5 percentage points, and frequently improves. Ultimately, MoE routing offers both an interpretable lens into reasoning states and a lightweight mechanism for optimizing test-time compute.
articles.titleCn: 推理路径：阅读与重塑MoE模型中的测试时计算
articles.abstractCn: 推理模型在测试时分配计算资源给不同的行为，如规划、推导和验证。然而，模型经常“过度思考”，在找到正确答案后继续验证和重新推导很长时间。这浪费了昂贵的计算资源，甚至可能降低性能。现有的干预措施，如令牌预算或引导，主要调节推理时长，而非针对特定行为。在这项工作中，我们证明专家混合（MoE）路由器提供了一个自然、无需训练的行为控制接口。我们首先将推理轨迹分割成句子级别的片段，并用六种推理行为之一（规划、执行、重述、事实、反思和结论）对每个片段进行标记，以便每个令牌都携带其片段的行为。路由器的线性探测器在路由器logits上的预测几乎与在残差流（模型的完整隐藏状态和探测的标准目标）上的探测一样好，但使用的特征大约少了一半。这些信号具有泛化能力：与一个数据集上的推理行为相关的专家在其它数据集上也预测相同的行为，跨越了涵盖五个领域（数学、代码、科学、知识和常识）的六个数据集。基于此，我们在推理过程中选择性地编辑专家路由器分数以遏制过度思考。在四个模型和四个基准测试中，这种干预措施将生成的令牌数量减少了中位数30.4%（最高达63.3%）。关键在于，它鼓励模型在问题解决后停止，而不是跳过必要的推理步骤。准确率从未下降超过0.5个百分点，并且经常有所提高。最终，MoE路由既提供了一个理解推理状态的解释性视角，也提供了一个优化测试时计算资源的轻量级机制。

articles.title: Autonomous agents for electricity-system planning
articles.abstract: Planning electricity systems requires repeated decisions that connect regional resources, investment, operation and network constraints. Here we present an autonomous planning framework that carries prepared regional scenarios through proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign and final plan selection. Agents propose investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions, interpret numerical feedback, and decide how to revise designs and when to stop. The framework automatically executes annual investment-and-dispatch optimization and representative-feeder verification, applies fixed acceptance criteria and retains the lowest-cost accepted candidate. We evaluate forty carbon-constrained trajectories across ten system-year scenarios in five electricity systems and four countries, using two model deployments and single- and multi-agent architectures. All forty retain candidates satisfying the implemented physical and fixed annual operational carbon-budget checks. Twenty-eight of forty matched reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings. A separate archive of ninety-six trajectories under a common 1,000 Mt annual ceiling provides matched references and broader regional coverage. The results demonstrate autonomous planning under explicit emissions constraints using public regional data and published institutional demand outlooks.
articles.titleCn: 电力系统规划中的自主代理
articles.abstractCn: 电力系统规划需要反复决策，以连接区域资源、投资、运营和网络约束。这里我们提出一个自主规划框架，通过方案提案、数值评估、反馈解读、重新设计和最终方案选择来处理准备好的区域情景。代理提出投资限额、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施，解读数值反馈，并决定如何修改设计以及何时停止。该框架自动执行年度投资与调度优化和代表性馈线验证，应用固定的接受标准，并保留成本最低的接受候选方案。我们在五个电力系统和四个国家中，针对十个系统年情景，使用两种模型部署和单代理与多代理架构，评估了四十个碳约束轨迹。所有四十个候选方案均满足实施的物理条件和固定年度运营碳预算检查。其中二十八个候选方案与参考设计匹配，并超过了新情景上限。一个独立的档案包含在共同的每年1,000 Mt上限下的九十六个轨迹，提供匹配参考和更广泛的区域覆盖。结果表明，利用公共区域数据和已发布的机构需求展望，在明确的排放约束下进行自主规划。

articles.title: Selective, Risk-Controlled Emotion Forecasting in Conversation: From a Persistence Barrier to Departure Detection with Conformal Guarantees
articles.abstract: Forecasting emotion in conversation is increasingly framed as predicting the next emotional state's value. We show this targets a hard quantity in a state-observed testbed and propose a learnable, deployable reformulation instead. On valence-arousal-dominance trajectories from a dyadic corpus, repeating a speaker's own previous state sets a persistence baseline that no frozen-encoder correction meaningfully improves upon and a state-space filter exceeds; the floor requires the historical state to be observed, since an estimated anchor collapses persistence below a direct forecaster. What survives is the timing of a departure from persistence, learnable on three of four corpora and near chance on the highest-base-rate corpus, a negative result we report. We recast the task as selective departure forecasting: a lead-time-weighted metric with a leakage protocol, and commitment policies whose best choice switches with the departure rate. A dialogue-level conformal risk control bounds the expected loss of committed predictions, meeting the target in all twelve configurations tested, though the guarantee is bought through abstention, with coverage and alarm recall falling sharply on the hardest corpus. One tested language model's confidence fails as a ranking signal where another succeeds, a model-dependent failure not yet attributable to family versus scale. Code and result logs are available from the corresponding author upon request.
articles.titleCn: 对话中的选择性、风险控制情绪预测：从持久性障碍到具有一致性保证的偏离检测
articles.abstractCn: 在对话中预测情绪状态正越来越多地被定义为预测下一个情绪状态的值。我们表明这种方法针对的是一个在状态观测测试平台上的难题，并提出了一种可学习、可部署的重新表述方法。在二元语料库的效价-唤醒-支配轨迹中，重复说话者自己的先前状态设定了一个持久性基线，而冻结编码器校正无法显著改进该基线，状态空间过滤器则超越了该基线；最低限度要求历史状态必须被观测到，因为估计的锚点会导致持久性低于直接预测器。留存的是从持久性中偏离的时间，可在四分之三的语料库上学习，在最高基率的语料库上接近随机水平，这是一个负结果，我们在此报告。我们将任务重新定义为选择性偏离预测：一个带泄漏协议的领先时间加权指标，以及其最佳选择随偏离率变化的承诺策略。对话级别的符合风险控制限制了承诺预测的预期损失，在所有测试的十二种配置中都达到了目标，尽管这种保证是通过放弃实现的，在最难处理的语料库上覆盖率和警报召回率急剧下降。一个测试的语言模型的置信度作为排序信号失效，而另一个模型则成功，这种模型相关的失效尚未归因于家族与规模。代码和结果日志可在要求时向通讯作者获取。

articles.title: Information-Matched Auditing of Conversational Emotion-Shift Forecasting: A Leakage-Safe Evaluation Protocol
articles.abstract: Comparisons in conversational emotion-shift forecasting are easily distorted when a learned model receives rich features but its transition baseline is given a noisy or unavailable current-emotion label, when hyperparameter budgets differ, or when target-turn information enters the representation. We present an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol that closes these gaps with an explicit commitment point, executable causality tests, equal four-configuration validation searches, and seed-dialogue-aware inference. Applying it to six causal model families on four text corpora and two feature-source sensitivity configurations shows that a deployable train-only current-emotion classifier feeding the transition baseline yields a different verdict than an oracle diagnostic where both sides receive gold current emotion. Under the deployable condition, learned models improve over the predicted-label baseline on all four primary corpora; DailyDialog gains are large and survive a 72-comparison Holm correction (best ROC-AUC gain = +0.167, adjusted p=.0144). Under matched gold information, the baseline remains competitive on IEMOCAP and stronger on MELD, while every model retains a large DailyDialog advantage. We additionally report precision-recall AUC, calibration, a strictly utterance-local feature control, same-person self-shift forecasting, and a future-access dose-response test. An eight-item leakage checklist accompanies the protocol. Code, raw seed predictions, and reporting artifacts are available from the corresponding author upon request.
articles.titleCn: 对话情绪转换预测的信息匹配审计：一种安全无泄露的评估协议
articles.abstractCn: 在对话情绪转变预测中，当学习模型获得丰富特征但其转变基线被赋予噪声或不存在的当前情绪标签、超参数预算不同，或目标轮次信息进入表示时，比较结果很容易被扭曲。我们提出了一种信息匹配、防泄漏审计协议，通过明确的承诺点、可执行的因果性测试、相等的四配置验证搜索和种子对话感知推理来弥补这些差距。将其应用于四个文本语料库和两种特征源敏感性配置上的六种因果模型家族，表明可部署的训练仅当前情绪分类器为转变基线提供输入时，会得出与双方都接收黄金当前情绪的预言诊断不同的结论。在可部署条件下，学习模型在所有四个主要语料库上均优于预测标签基线；DailyDialog的收益显著，并通过72次比较的Holm校正后依然稳健（最佳ROC-AUC收益=+0.167，调整p值=0.0144）。在匹配黄金信息下，基线在IEMOCAP上保持竞争力，在MELD上表现更强，而每个模型在DailyDialog上仍保持显著优势。此外，我们还报告了精确率-召回率AUC、校准度、严格的语句局部特征控制、同人自我情绪转变预测以及未来访问剂量反应测试。该协议附有一份八项泄漏检查清单。代码、原始种子预测和报告工件可在要求时向通讯作者获取。

articles.title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
articles.abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.
articles.comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Ancillary files include a public rendering of the confirmation protocol and summary results
articles.titleCn: 在何种情况下，更高的置信度能提升知识图谱审计效果？
articles.abstractCn: 置信度估计指导着基于LLM构建的知识图谱的人工审核，但更精确的错误预测在审计中可能带来微小的改进。我们通过可修复性、选择余量和标签有效性来研究这一差距。将非自适应审计建模为预算覆盖问题，我们刻画了最小决策相关错误统计量，并通过结构质量$Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$界定了保持标量的第一阶规划策略的遗憾值。我们在Re-DocRED上模拟了针对五个提取配置和两个跨文档图的理想修复，随后在测试集上冻结确认，并在500个哈希选择的训练文档上进行复制。在保留的跨文档图中，错误率×扇出队列留下的错误比具有相同动作的联合模型多3.98-4.74个百分点。相比之下，为该联合规划器开放共享动作，相对于其自身仅基于事实的计划，在点估计上减少了0.89-1.43个百分点的残余错误。联合模型与独立块模型之间的等价性尚未得出结论。通用LLM验证提高了每个保留集上四分之三模型预算配置的性能。LLM裁决识别了可能的基准遗漏。

articles.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.
articles.titleCn: CARTBench：基于评分标准的复杂和模糊请求的购物建议评估，含时间限制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）购物助手现在能在多轮对话中推荐产品。然而，可靠的评估面临数据稀缺和难度标准难以统一的问题。为解决这些障碍，我们推出了CARTBench，用于处理复杂且模糊的带时间限制请求（CART）。针对数据稀缺问题，我们从17个零售领域的真实商业购物需求中整理案例，将带时间戳的对话与1603条产品记录进行匹配。对于难度标准统一问题，我们开发了基于理想响应原则的案例特定评分标准，这些原则是从成功完成的订单中手动挑选的优秀回复中提炼出来的。这些原则也指导了我们的结构化推荐策略——原则引导式CART提示。实验基准包含1328条由专家标注的核心、卓越和安全标准。为回答CART问题，我们评估了7个旗舰商业API模型，包括GPT-6.1-Sol和Claude-Opus-5，以及参数超过35B的开权重量级模型。在冻结评分标准下的首次全面评估中，10个模型中有3个在核心标准上超过90%，但没有模型在卓越标准上超过45%。因此，我们发现了所需行为与高质量购买建议之间的理解到执行差距。为检验这些局限性，我们诊断了产品证据和未解决需求中的共同失败，这些失败与不断变化的需求和决定性未知因素相关。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench获取。

articles.title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
articles.abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/lililibaohang/TandemBench.
articles.titleCn: TandemBench：用于多智能体协作的决策模型基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型在路径规划和动作选择等任务中从预定义选项中进行选择。在多智能体协作中，一个决策决定了成员如何分配工作、交换资源和并行行动。我们介绍了TandemBench，这是一个包含1200个问题的多智能体烹饪场景基准，其中协调选择会影响目标完成情况。模型接收完整的全局信息和候选团队计划，参考答案通过执行和精确搜索建立。模型选择最优团队计划，并在保留或移除该计划的配对变体中，判断是否存在超越提供选项的更好安排。我们评估了40个原生决策模型，并将它们与10个通用语言模型进行比较。最佳原生决策模型的决策准确率达到62.50%。原生决策模型在最优性验证方面仍接近随机水平。配对测试显示，即使已存在最优计划，有些模型仍报告存在更好的替代方案。这些结果表明，仅凭团队计划决策的准确率可能掩盖了在判断提供选项是否包含最优安排时存在的系统性错误。数据集和评估代码已公开发布在https://github.com/lililibaohang/TandemBench。

articles.title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.
articles.titleCn: 当人类决策至关重要时学习：执行者相对咨询价值对大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地自动化复杂任务，但人类决策能力并不随其能力提升而扩展。在许多应用中，人类仍然不可或缺，因为他们能够提供智能体无法获取的隐私上下文、权威或判断。我们提出了人类决策能力分配问题：在多个咨询机会和有限预算的约束下，大型语言模型智能体应该在哪些决策时咨询人类？核心挑战在于评估咨询价值，因为相同的输入可能对不同下游智能体产生不同的效益，导致咨询价值具有执行者依赖性。我们引入了咨询价值蒸馏（CVD）方法，该方法利用蒙特卡洛执行者展开在离线环境中估计咨询价值，并将这些价值蒸馏为轻量级预测器，用于预算分配，无需在部署时进行基于展开的价值估计。在包含两个前沿执行者的五个批量处理和三个序列设置中，CVD通过联合学习和延续感知价值学习改进分配效果，同时独立咨询价值在多个设置中保持竞争力。CVD还广泛优于直接提示和信息的价值，在适用情况下表现优异，且在大幅减少展开监督的情况下保持稳健，并能在低搜索成本下实现近乎无损的近似分配。

articles.title: Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation
articles.abstract: Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.

articles.titleCn: 在推理时专家停用时匹配训练时间权重规则
articles.abstractCn: 在推理时专家失效会同时改变token路由和专家权重，其对性能的影响取决于这些改变是如何实现的。我们在四个模型家族的五个指令微调检查点中，对相同的禁用集比较了移除、冻结、剩余专家重新归一化和未归一化重新路由的效果，并以一个基础OLMoE检查点作为额外比较。我们开发了一个权重和模型，将专家贡献的损失和分支比例的变化与训练期间使用的权重规则联系起来。根据基于激活的排名，当一半专家被失效时，在原始路由概率训练的模型中，剩余专家重新归一化产生了最高的困惑度，而在归一化权重训练的模型中，未归一化重新路由产生了最高的困惑度。当保留训练规则时，困惑度范围在完整基线的1.4到73倍之间，而在规则不匹配的情况下，困惑度范围在14到28,740倍之间。任务结果因评估类型而异：在OLMoE上，GSM8K严格匹配准确率在所有四种实现下都降至零。将模型扩展到活跃专家数量的变化产生进一步预测，OLMoE实验支持了这一点：随着激活的专家数量减少，额外重新归一化的困惑度惩罚增加。

articles.title: Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models
articles.abstract: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Probing reveals that tone is highly decodable from embeddings and improves modestly across layers, whereas segmental information starts less decodable and improves substantially with depth. Activation steering shows that segmental representations can systematically influence generation, while tone exhibits much weaker effects. Furthermore, audio-bearing training improves phonological decodability, including tone, without corresponding improvements in steering effectiveness. Together, these findings reveal distinct representational and functional profiles for segmental and tonal information, with tonal information much harder to access and manipulate, demonstrating the necessity for combined evaluation, probing, and causal intervention for understanding linguistic knowledge in LMs.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中的汉字语音知识
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LMs）对中国汉字的音韵知识掌握程度如何，以及这些知识是如何被表征和使用的？我们介绍了PinyinBench，这是一个涵盖同音字、音韵特征（声母、韵母和声调）以及多音字的可控基准。我们通过三种互补的方法——行为评估、逐层探测和激活引导——对17个纯文本和多模态语言模型进行了研究。行为上，模型表现出对声母和韵母的显著知识，其中前沿模型（DS-v4-flash）在同音字判断中得分超过90%，当两个汉字没有任何音韵特征时。然而，当两个汉字仅声调不同时，其准确率急剧下降至72%。探测显示，声调可以从嵌入中高度解码，并在各层中略有提升，而音节信息解码度较低，但随着深度增加显著提高。激活引导表明，音节表征可以系统地影响生成，而声调的影响则弱得多。此外，包含音频的训练提高了音韵解码能力，包括声调，但并未相应提升引导效果。综合这些发现，揭示了音节信息和声调信息具有不同的表征和功能特征，其中声调信息更难被访问和操纵，这表明了结合评估、探测和因果干预的必要性，以理解LM中的语言知识。

articles.title: How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation
articles.abstract: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts, at levels far exceeding those observed among human authors. Follow up factor analyses showed that training set consistency was the most robust predictor of mimicry success across models, whereas author distinctiveness did not generalise as a reliable predictor. Global embedding visualisations further revealed a consistent macro level pattern: for most models, generated texts occupied regions of the embedding space that were largely separated from the corresponding human training clusters. This indicates limited convergence towards target author style and suggests the presence of model specific lexical and phraseological preferences. The findings highlight the importance of distinguishing genuine stylistic imitation from direct textual reuse and have implications for the forensic analysis of textual evidence involving potential LLM enabled impersonation.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型模仿个体作者的能力如何？一项比较评估
articles.abstractCn: 本研究调查了六种广泛使用的大型语言模型（LLM）：Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus、GPT 5.2、GPT 5.2 Pro、DeepSeek 3.2 和 Grok 4.1 Fast 的作者身份模仿能力。评估使用的是选定的简短产品评论文本，以确保个体写作风格的高内部一致性。设计了两种类型的上下文提示：一种包含最少指令的简单提示，以及一种包含明确文体学指导以模仿的复杂提示。作者身份模仿通过基于余弦距离的训练指标距离进行评估，并辅以嵌入分布的视觉分析。结果表明，对于大多数LLM，作者身份模仿仍然是一项挑战，Gemini 3 Pro 表现出最强的明显模仿性能。然而，随后的重叠分析揭示，Gemini 3 Pro 大量复制并重用了训练文本中的句子和短语，其程度远超人类作者观察到的水平。后续的因子分析表明，训练集一致性是跨模型模仿成功的最稳健预测指标，而作者独特性并未作为可靠的预测指标泛化。全局嵌入可视化进一步揭示了一种一致的大尺度模式：对于大多数模型，生成的文本占据了嵌入空间中与相应人类训练集群大范围分离的区域。这表明向目标作者风格的收敛有限，并表明存在模型特定的词汇和短语偏好。研究结果表明区分真正的文体模仿与直接文本重用的重要性，并对涉及潜在LLM支持的模仿的文本证据的法医学分析具有启示意义。
